papers.title:
The habitat use of ariid catfishes in coral reefs in northeastern
                    <scp>Brazil</scp>
papers.authors: Lima, Romullo Guimarães; Soares, Bruno Eleres; da Silva Pereira, Clecio; Bezerra, Wesley Ruan Fernandes; da Silva, Paloma Rocha; Jesuino, Livian Kertleen Pôrto; dos Santos Gemaque, Mariana Vitória; Soares, Carlos Alberto Cavalcanti; Vendel, Ana Lúcia; Marceniuk, Alexandre P.
papers.abstract: Abstract Ariidae species occur across a wide range of habitats from freshwater to fully marine environments and are typically associated with soft‐bottom substrates. However, they are sometimes associated with hard‐bottom substrates such as coral reefs, but such association is poorly documented. This study describes the occurrence and habitat use of six ariid species in the coral reef of Penha Beach, northeastern Brazil. We deployed gill nets monthly alongside the coral reef over a year between 2023 and 2024, and we sampled 256 individuals representing six ariid species. Bagre filamentosus , a marine catfish, was the most abundant species throughout the year. Species composition varied seasonally, and an RDA analysis showed that variation in species abundances was associated with precipitation and air temperature, with Cathorops spixii occurring primarily during the wet season. B. filamentosus and Sciades proops showed male‐biased sex ratios across all seasons (exact binomial tests), and males of B. filamentosus exhibited higher mass gain per unit length during the dry season (t‐test). Diet composition varied among months and according to the species' habitat affinity, although effect sizes were small and seasonal differences were weak. These findings suggest that ariid catfishes use coral reef systems as opportunistic foraging and refuge habitats, with habitat use probably linked to their life cycle and the connections between coral reefs and estuaries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在揭示巴西东北部珊瑚礁中海鲶科（Ariidae）鱼类的栖息地利用模式，该类群通常与软底质环境相关，其在硬底质珊瑚礁中的出现记录甚少。作者于2023—2024年在Penha Beach珊瑚礁旁每月布设刺网，共采集6种256尾个体，并结合RDA分析环境因子与物种丰度的关系。结果显示，Bagre filamentosus为全年优势种，群落组成呈季节性变化，与降水量和气温相关；B. filamentosus和Sciades proops各季节均呈雄性偏倚的性比，且前者旱季单位体长增重更高。研究表明，海鲶科鱼类将珊瑚礁作为机会性摄食与庇护栖息地，其栖息地利用可能与生活史及珊瑚礁—河口连通性有关。

papers.title: Decellularized Fish Swim Bladder Extracellular Matrix–Polycaprolactone Composite Material for Application in Small‐Diameter Vascular Grafts
papers.authors: Wu, Yifan; Xu, Minghao; Wang, Xixi; Wang, Chijia; Wang, Zhihong; Liu, Jing
papers.journal: Journal of Biomedical Materials Research Part A
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The high incidence of cardiovascular diseases has led to an increasing demand for small‐diameter vascular grafts. Polycaprolactone (PCL) is a commonly used synthetic polymer material in the construction of vascular grafts. However, PCL alone has limited bioactivity, which may affect its blood‐contacting and tissue responses when used in small‐diameter vascular grafts. Fish swim bladder‐derived extracellular matrix (FSB–ECM) contains bioactive components such as collagen and has been investigated as a cardiovascular biomaterial, although its mechanical properties are limited. In this study, fish swim bladder‐derived dECM was incorporated into PCL by electrospinning to fabricate a series of small‐diameter vascular grafts. The study first confirmed that dECM was successfully loaded onto PCL fibers and significantly improved the hydrophilicity and degradation performance of the material. Based on the in vitro and ex vivo evaluations, the 15% PCL–dECM (3:7) formulation was selected for further in vivo testing because it showed a favorable balance of mechanical properties and hemocompatibility, including low platelet activation. Subsequent in vivo evaluation in a rat abdominal artery implantation model demonstrated that this dECM‐modified graft achieved a 100% patency rate. Furthermore, it exhibited significant anti‐inflammatory effects and was conducive to the organized deposition of extracellular matrix components, such as collagen and elastic fibers. This work successfully developed a novel small‐diameter vascular graft that possesses both excellent bioactivity and mechanical properties. Our findings offer a promising strategy and a solid experimental foundation, supporting the future clinical translation of small‐diameter vascular grafts.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究将鱼鳔来源脱细胞细胞外基质（FSB-dECM）通过静电纺丝掺入聚己内酯（PCL），制备小口径血管移植物，以改善PCL单独使用时生物活性不足的问题。体外及离体评价表明，15% PCL-dECM（3:7）配方在力学性能与血液相容性间取得良好平衡，并被选用于大鼠腹主动脉植入实验。体内结果显示该移植物通畅率达100%，具有显著抗炎效果并促进胶原与弹性纤维的有序沉积，为小口径血管移植物的临床转化提供了新策略与实验依据。

papers.title: Impact of light pollution on fishes: Mechanisms and ecological consequences
papers.authors: Chen, Hanxi; Candolin, Ulrika
papers.abstract: Abstract The increasing prevalence of artificial light at night (ALAN) is of growing ecological concern. By altering natural light regimes, ALAN affects the behaviour, physiology and life‐history of organisms. While research has largely focused on terrestrial ecosystems, aquatic ecosystems are increasingly exposed. Here, we systematically review current knowledge of the impacts of ALAN on fishes and the underlying mechanisms and ecological consequences. We first discuss the factors influencing fish exposure to ALAN and how light can exert both direct and indirect effects. We then examine the potential consequences of these responses for ecosystem structure and functions, considering interactions with other environmental stressors, such as warming, noise and chemical pollution. To assess the current state of knowledge, we systematically review the literature. We find that most studies have focussed on the direct effects of ALAN on fish behaviour and physiology, whereas the fitness consequences of these responses and the impacts on population dynamics, species interactions and community composition remain largely unexplored. Notably, no study has assessed the broader implications for ecosystem functions. We identify key research priorities to advance understanding of both the short‐ and long‐term effects of ALAN on fishes and to inform effective mitigation strategies. In particular, more research is needed on the ecological consequences of fish responses to ALAN. We conclude by discussing potential solutions to light pollution, emphasising the importance of integrating economic, social and environmental considerations in the development of environmentally friendly lighting practices.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了夜间人造光（ALAN）对鱼类的直接与间接影响机制及其生态后果，并评估了其与变暖、噪声和化学污染等环境胁迫因子的交互作用。文献分析表明，现有研究多聚焦于ALAN对鱼类行为和生理的直接效应，而对其适合度后果、种群动态、种间关系及群落组成的影响仍鲜有探讨，生态系统功能层面的研究更是空白。作者据此提出关键研究优先方向，并强调在制定环境友好型照明方案时需综合经济、社会与环境考量。

papers.title: Value chain performance and market dynamics of small-scale bivalve fisheries: a case study from coastal cox’s bazar, Bangladesh
papers.authors: Hossain, Khandakar Zakir; Rashid, Faisal; Rahman Khan, Mohammad Sadequr; Asaduzzaman, Md
papers.abstract: Small-scale bivalve fisheries in coastal Bangladesh constitute a vital yet highly informal sub-sector that is largely neglected in national fisheries governance frameworks. This study investigates the value chain performance, market dynamics, and socioeconomic contributions of artisanal bivalve fisheries across two distinct coastal systems in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh: Chawfaldandi (a well-connected mainland site) and Moheshkhali (a geographically isolated offshore island). A cross-sectional comparative field survey was conducted during the peak harvesting season (November 2025–April 2026). Employing a multi-stage purposive and snowball sampling strategy, primary data were gathered through face-to-face interviews from 150 stakeholders of each site across three specific nodes: harvesters/collectors (n=50), traders/retailers (n=50), and consumer households (n=50). The study focused on three economically important wild bivalve species: the Indian backwater oyster (Crassostrea madrasensis), the green mussel (Perna viridis), and the Asiatic hard clam (Meretrix meretrix). Despite substantial latent export and domestic tourism-driven potential, the sector remains constrained by its informal nature, wild stock dependence, and monsoon-driven seasonality. Implementing targeted strategies, such as community-based depuration systems, insulated ice storage, formal marketing cooperatives, certification of bivalve products, can significantly improve product safety, optimize income distribution for vulnerable coastal communities, and integrate these "hidden" small-scale fisheries into the broader blue economy framework.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以孟加拉国Cox's Bazar沿海两处典型区域（陆域Chawfaldandi与离岛Moheshkhali）为对象，通过收获季跨区域问卷调查（每站点150名利益相关者，覆盖采捕者、贸易商和消费家庭三个节点），比较分析了印度后湾牡蛎、绿贻贝和亚洲硬壳蛤三种经济双壳类小规模渔业的value chain绩效与市场动态。结果显示，该非正式子行业虽具出口与国内旅游消费潜力，但受制于野生种群依赖、季风季节性及治理缺位。作者建议通过社区净化系统、冷链储运、营销合作社和产品认证等干预措施，提升产品安全并优化脆弱沿海社区的收入分配，将其纳入blue economy框架。

papers.title: Assessment of Microplastic Ingestion in Freshwater Fish Labeo Rohita From the Indus River Crossing Dera Ismail Khan
papers.authors: Afira Afsheen; Ruqia Bibi; Nida Khalid; Sumbal
papers.journal: Kashmir Journal of Academic Research and Development
papers.abstract: The increasing contamination of MP’s in aquatic environment particularly in fresh water ecosystem has become a serious challenge for human health fresh water system like Indus river system is an important transport routes for plastic contamination however the research regarding on micro plastic ingestion in commercially impotent fish species remains limited There for the present study was aimed to investigate the ingestion of micro plastic in fresh water fish Labeo rohita on the basis of size, color and shape. A Total of 100 fish specimen were collected from three different sites of Indus River Dera Ismail Khan the three locations are named as upstream, midstream and downstream. The fish specimen were collected between November 2025 to April 2026. The Gastrointestinal Tracts of each specimen is removed after dissection for further analysis the GIT tract is digested in 30% hydrogen per oxide solution to is date organic materials the solution was incubate at 48c’ and then Filters through Filter paper the filter paper contain the remaining particles was dried in a laboratory oven at 37c’ After drying the filter paper was examined under a compound microscope. The extracted MPs were identified and characterized based on their size shape and color on way Anova and correlation test were carried out to determine the variance and relationship with fish biometric parameters. Results revealed that 78% of fish contained microplastics, with a sum of 156 molecules detected along with a mean profusion of 1.56 ± 1.21 items per fish. The predominant type was fibers (67%), then succeeded by films (14%), lines (10%), fragments (6%), and foam (3%). Black-colored particles were most prevalent (29%). Microplastic abundance was significantly higher at downstream sites (p = 0.017), and showed positive correlations with body length (R² = 0.41), body weight (R² = 0.46), and gut weight (R² = 0.39). Labeo rohita from the Indus River are significantly exposed to microplastic contamination. It is recommended that continuous monitoring, enhanced management of garbage practices, and consciousness of the public programs be implemented to reduce microplastic waste in freshwater habitat.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了印度河Dera Ismail Khan段淡水鱼Labeo rohita对微塑料的摄入情况，按尺寸、颜色和形状对胃肠道中提取的微塑料进行鉴定与表征。结果显示78%的样本含有微塑料，平均丰度为1.56 ± 1.21 items/鱼，以纤维（67%）和黑色颗粒（29%）为主，下游站点丰度显著更高，且与体长、体重及肠道重量呈正相关。研究表明该河段Labeo rohita面临显著的微塑料暴露风险，建议加强持续监测与垃圾管理。

papers.title: Grass carp reovirus activates fish Ppp1r3g to suppress innate immunity and exacerbate hemorrhage via the 14-3-3ζ/Itgb3 signaling axis
papers.authors: Wang, Ruyi; Zhou, Man; Wang, Yuxuan; Hu, Xudong; Zhang, Han; Cao, Hong
papers.abstract: Protein phosphatase 1 regulatory subunit 3G (PPP1R3G) is one of the regulatory subunits of protein phosphatase 1 (PP1). Current research on PPP1R3G is primarily focused on glycogen synthesis and lipid metabolism. However, the role of ppp1r3g in the innate immune response of fish has not been completely elucidated. This study demonstrated that ppp1r3g regulates RLR signaling pathway through interactions with Rig-I, Mda5, and Traf6. In parallel, Ppp1r3g inhibits platelet activation by regulating 14-3-3 zeta (14-3-3ζ) and consequently modulating the formation of the 14-3-3ζ-integrin-β3 (Itgb3) complex. In vivo analysis revealed that compared with the wild-type controls, ppp1r3g -null rare minnow ( Gobiocypris rarus ) and ppp1r3g -chimera grass carp ( Ctenopharyngodon idella ) exhibited significantly enhanced resistance to grass carp reovirus (GCRV), with markedly alleviated hemorrhagic symptoms post-infection. Furthermore, knockdown of ppp1r3g suppressed GCRV replication and upregulated type I interferon (IFN-1) expression in grass carp kidney (CIK) cells. Additionally, Ppp1r3g binds to the -ESKVFYLKMKGDYYRYL- fragment (EL17) of 14-3-3ζ via the Ser36/37 phosphorylation site located on the PP1c domain. This study also demonstrated that 14-3-3ζ interacts with Itgb3 through this fragment, indicating that Ppp1r3g competes with Itgb3 to bind 14-3-3ζ. Furthermore, Ppp1r3g dose-dependently promoted Itgb3 degradation via a proteolytic pathway. These findings indicate that Ppp1r3g negatively regulates innate antiviral immunity after GCRV stimulation and suppresses platelet and coagulation cascade activation by modulating the interaction between 14-3-3ζ and Itgb3 in fish.
papers.summary_cn: 草鱼呼肠孤病毒（GCRV）感染激活宿主蛋白磷酸酶1调节亚基Ppp1r3g，进而抑制先天抗病毒免疫并加重出血症状。研究发现Ppp1r3g通过与Rig-I、Mda5和Traf6互作负调控RLR信号通路，同时经14-3-3ζ/Itgb3轴抑制血小板活化与凝血级联反应。体内实验表明，ppp1r3g缺失的稀有鮈鲫和嵌合草鱼对GCRV抗性显著增强、出血症状明显减轻；细胞水平敲低ppp1r3g可抑制病毒复制并上调I型干扰素表达。机制上，Ppp1r3g通过其PP1c结构域Ser36/37磷酸化位点结合14-3-3ζ的EL17片段，竞争性阻断Itgb3与14-3-3ζ的结合，并剂量依赖性地经蛋白水解途径促进Itgb3降解。

papers.title: Wild-harvested Marphysa madrasi for biosecure aquaculture: nutritional profiling, pathogen screening, and phylogenetic assessment
papers.authors: Atchuthan, P.; Jaikumar, Muthuswamy; Ramadoss, Dineshram; Periasamy, Rengaiyan; Behera, Anil Kumar
papers.abstract: Abstract Polychaetes are widely used as high-value aquaculture feed, yet India continues to depend heavily on imported species despite the availability of locally abundant taxa. However, the nutritional potential, biosafety, and taxonomic clarity of indigenous polychaetes remain poorly characterized. This study addresses this gap by assessing the suitability of the underutilized speciesMarphysa madrasi Hutchings, Lavesque, Priscilla, Daffe, Malathi & Glasby, 2020 as a sustainable , locally sourced feed resource for aquaculture. Field observations were conducted across intertidal zones near Chennai to document harvesting activities, harvesting intensity and species occurrence. Morphological and molecular analyses confirmed the taxonomy of M. madrasi , and screening for major pathogens, including White Spot Syndrome Virus and Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei , showed no detectable infection. Nutritional profiling revealed a high protein content and a favourable fatty acid composition, including saturated, monounsaturated, and polyunsaturated fatty acids relevant to broodstock nutrition. Together, these results demonstrate that M. madrasi possesses desirable nutritional and biosafety characteristics, supporting its potential integration into Indian aquaculture value chains. These findings highlight opportunities to reduce reliance on expensive imported polychaetes, promote local livelihoods, and encourage sustainable harvesting and the development of future polychaete cultivation strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了印度本地未充分利用的多毛类 Marphysa madrasi 作为水产养殖饲料资源的潜力，通过形态学与分子鉴定确认其分类地位，并开展病原筛查（WSSV、EHP）及营养成分分析。结果显示该物种未检出主要病原感染，且蛋白质含量高、脂肪酸组成优良，适用于亲本营养强化。研究支持将 M. madrasi 纳入印度水产养殖价值链，以减少对进口多毛类的依赖并促进本地可持续采收。

papers.title: A quantum-inspired multi-objective learning framework for real-time sustainable aquaculture water quality prediction
papers.authors: Abdel-Aty, Abdel-Haleem; Almalki, Ali Jaber; Ghorashi, Sara A.; Voon, Betty Wan Niu; Hafez, Mohamed
papers.abstract: Management of sustainable aquaculture necessitates accurate prediction of water quality parameters, since environmental variability is an important factor in determining aquatic productivity and ecological stability. Traditional machine learning systems are usually limited by inefficient parameter optimization, feature overlap, and limited adaptability to non-linear and time-varying environmental trends. To address these issues, a new concept is proposed, which is called Quantum-Inspired Aquaculture Optimization Network (Q-AQUAOptNet). To improve the process of feature selection, hyperparameter optimization, and model stability before temporal prediction, the proposed architecture combines sustainability index modeling and quantum-inspired multi-objective evolutionary optimization. The optimization approach balances exploration and exploitation, enhancing the learning ability of the prediction model. Implementation of the framework was done through Python-based simulation tools in preprocessing, optimization, and performance evaluation. The created system had a Root Mean Square Error of 0.24, a Mean Absolute Error of 0.21, and an R 2 of 0.97, which means that it has effective predictive power and a great ability to explain the variance. Integrating evolutionary optimization and temporal learning improves generalization performance and reduces prediction uncertainty. The findings demonstrate that Q-AQUAOptNet provides effective predictive performance within a simulation-based framework and shows potential as a sustainability-oriented intelligent water-quality monitoring and decision support system for aquaculture applications.
papers.summary_cn: 针对可持续水产养殖水质参数预测中传统机器学习参数优化效率低、特征重叠及对非线性时变环境适应性差的问题，提出量子启发式多目标优化网络Q-AQUAOptNet，融合可持续性指数建模与量子启发多目标进化优化以改进特征选择、超参数优化和时序预测稳定性。基于Python仿真实现，模型RMSE为0.24、MAE为0.21、R²为0.97，显示有效预测能力与方差解释力。结果表明该框架在仿真条件下具备良好泛化性能，有望作为面向可持续性的水产养殖智能水质监测与决策支持系统。

papers.title: Defining and finding the profit for seaweed secondary extensive aquaculture
papers.authors: Froehlich, Halley E.; Campbell, Rose S.; Miller, Kathy Ann; Johnson, Kevin M.; Fleener, Gary; Kroeker, Kristy J.
papers.abstract: Seaweed aquaculture is expanding globally, yet small-scale producers, such as those emerging in the United States, face challenges in achieving economic viability. We introduce and formalize the concept of secondary extensive aquaculture (SEA): the non-target cultivation, harvest, and use of extractive species (e.g., seaweeds) that naturally recruit and grow on existing aquaculture infrastructure designed for a different primary species (e.g., oysters). To explore the economic viability of SEA, we employed a scenario-based bioeconomic modeling approach, coupling logistic seaweed growth and sustainable harvest with a simple profit function. The model was parameterized with literature-derived ranges for seaweed growth and carrying capacity, as well as data from a 2025 pilot harvest on a 65 ha oyster farm in California. Using simulations, we evaluated key ecological and economic combinations under which seaweed SEA may offset the estimated 5-10% production losses associated with typical, unharvested biofouling. We showed that profitability increased with farm size, growing season length, and intrinsic growth rate ( r ) of seaweed, with viable scenarios typically requiring &gt; 50-100 ha and &gt; 60 growing days under conservative market assumptions ($400 t -1 wet weight). Intrinsic growth rate exerted a stronger influence on profitability than carrying capacity ( K ), indicating that faster-growing seaweed species (e.g., Ulva spp., Gracilaria spp., and Pyropia spp.) are more suitable candidates for SEA. In fact, modal ecological conditions on a 65 ha farm may offset biofouling costs. Labor intensity, however, emerged as a major bottleneck, with pilot-informed labor estimates (~140-200 hrs. t -1 including processing) far exceeding the ca. 10 hrs. t -1 needed to breakeven at minimum wage, but could be achieved with realistic improved efficiency. Although our pilot SEA yields fell near the lower bound of global seaweed aquaculture production, they remain within plausible commercial ranges. Overall, SEA represents a promising complementary strategy for diversifying revenue streams and enhancing circularity in aquaculture systems, but its realization will depend on sufficient scale, favorable biological productivity, labor efficiency improvements, and supportive policy frameworks.
papers.summary_cn: 研究提出并形式化了“secondary extensive aquaculture (SEA)”概念，即在牡蛎等主养品种的现有设施上，非目标性地采收自然附生的海藻。通过耦合logistic生长模型与利润函数的生物经济情景模拟，并以加州65 ha牡蛎养殖场2025年试点采收数据参数化，评估其经济可行性。结果表明，盈利性随养殖规模、生长季长度和海藻内禀增长率(r)提升，可行情景通常需>50–100 ha及>60个生长日（保守市场价$400 t⁻¹湿重），且r的影响强于环境容纳量(K)，快速生长种类（如Ulva、Gracilaria、Pyropia）更适宜。劳动力投入是主要瓶颈，但SEA有望抵消生物污损造成的5–10%产量损失，成为水产养殖多元增收与循环化的补充策略。

papers.title: A computational intelligence framework for multimodal oceanic data analysis and predictive modeling in sustainable marine resource management
papers.authors: Liu, Xuan
papers.abstract: Introduction The rapid expansion of ocean based economic activities and increasing anthropogenic pressures have made sustainable marine resource management a critical challenge in oceanic computing. Effective management of ocean ecosystems necessitates intelligent systems capable of integrating multimodal data, capturing spatiotemporal dynamics, and operating under uncertainty. Traditional approaches often rely on static optimization models or oversimplified biological assumptions, limiting their ability to address real world complexities such as ecological feedback, regulatory compliance, and conflicts among user groups. Methods To overcome these limitations, we propose a computational intelligence framework that integrates high resolution ecological modeling with dynamic decision making and decentralized governance mechanisms. Central to this framework is the ECO STORM model (Ecologically Constrained Optimization via Stochastic Temporal Resource Management), which employs a stochastic dynamic programming approach to unify biomass evolution, habitat conditions, and enforcement factors. Neural function approximators are utilized for value iteration, while softmax parametrized policies enable adaptive effort allocation at the regional level. Complementing this, we introduce AQUA GOV (Adaptive Quota and Uncertainty Aware Governance), a multi agent governance strategy that allocates quotas under ecological and regulatory constraints, incorporating user specific preferences and compliance risks. AQUA GOV features fairness aware quota adjustments, stochastic monitoring, and a reinforcement loop that integrates stakeholder feedback. This closed loop system effectively models, forecasts, and manages marine resources under uncertainty. Results and Discussion Experiments conducted in simulated marine environments demonstrate the framework’s ability to maintain ecological thresholds, ensure policy compliance, and optimize resource distribution among diverse user groups. This work provides a scalable and intelligent solution for advancing marine governance in data rich, heterogeneous, and ecologically sensitive seascapes.

papers.title: Local baselines reveal elevated groundwater nutrients, localised coastal enrichment, and broadly oligotrophic reef conditions in Laamu Atoll, Maldives
papers.authors: Arnull, Jessica; Hashim, Aminath Shaha; Ganeshram, Raja S.; Wilson, A. Meriwether W.; Moosa, Hassan; Reay, David S.; Ziyadh, Aishath Mufliha; Tudhope, Alexander W.
papers.abstract: Introduction Nutrient enrichment in coral reef systems is increasingly recognised as a major driver of ecological change, yet integrated assessments across groundwater, coastal, and reef environments remain limited in small island developing states (SIDS). Methods We assessed dissolved inorganic nutrients (total oxidised nitrogen, ammonium and phosphate), N:P ratios, and isotope-based tracers (δ 15 N, C:N) across groundwater, coastal-surface, and reef domains of Laamu Atoll, Maldives, between 2022 and 2024 to characterise spatial nutrient patterns and establish a baseline for environmental monitoring. Results Groundwater contained substantially higher nutrient concentrations – typically one to two orders of magnitude – than coastal-surface and reef waters, with several wells exceeding national drinking-water standards for ammonium. Coastal-surface waters showed localised nitrogen enrichment at several inhabited and poorly flushed shorelines, while reef waters remained characteristically oligotrophic with phosphate frequently below detection limits across most sites. N:P patterns suggested predominant, though not uniform, phosphorus limitation in groundwater, and more variable nutrient limitation across coastal and reef environments that differed by island and use-type context. Exploratory δ 15 N analysis in seagrass and macroalgal tissue showed weak group-level differences but localised enrichment near fish-processing and relative depletion near agricultural zones, while C:N ratios differed most strongly by species, with a secondary, weaker signal by land-use type. Discussion Together, these cross-domain nutrient gradients demonstrate clear spatial differences among groundwater, coastal-surface, and reef environments, consistent with localised nutrient enrichment in some nearshore settings and strong hydrodynamic control across the wider atoll. This study provides the first integrated nutrient baseline for Laamu Atoll, complemented by exploratory isotope data from a subset of islands, and contributes to the limited body of nutrient monitoring data available for coral reef systems in SIDS, supporting future monitoring and management of nutrient pressures associated with wastewater and agriculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究于2022—2024年在马尔代夫Laamu Atoll对地下水、近岸表层水和礁区水体开展溶解无机营养盐（总氧化氮、铵盐、磷酸盐）、N:P比及同位素示踪（δ¹⁵N、C:N）的综合基线调查，以刻画营养盐空间格局并建立环境监测基线。结果显示，地下水营养盐浓度较近岸和礁区水体高1—2个数量级，部分水井铵盐超国家饮用水标准；近岸水体在有人居住且水交换较差的岸段出现局部氮富集，而礁区总体维持贫营养（oligotrophic）状态，多数站点磷酸盐低于检出限。N:P格局指示地下水以磷限制为主，近岸与礁区营养限制因岛屿及利用类型而异；δ¹⁵N在鱼类加工区附近富集、农业区相对贫化。该研究提供了Laamu Atoll首个跨域营养盐基线，揭示了局部近岸富营养化与环礁尺度水动力控制的主导作用。

papers.title: A Noise-Aware Federated Learning Framework for Fish Spoilage Prediction in Small-Scale Fisheries: An Architecture-Controlled Performance Evaluation
papers.authors: Sospeter, Kelvin; Tesha, Gaudence
papers.journal: East African Journal of Information Technology
papers.abstract: Post-harvest fish spoilage remains a major challenge for small-scale fisheries in developing economies, with losses estimated at 25-30% attributed largely to inadequate cold chain monitoring at informal landing sites and markets. This paper presents a noise-aware Federated Learning (FL) framework for predicting fish spoilage risk, evaluated through an architecture-controlled comparison against a centralised baseline. Because a large, labelled dataset from operational cold chain deployments was unavailable, a synthetic dataset of 10,000 records was generated using environmental ranges reported in the literature and calibrated to reflect DHT22 sensor tolerances, explicitly separating true environmental conditions from sensor-reported values to model realistic calibration drift and measurement noise. An identical Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) architecture was used for both the centralised baseline and the federated system, implemented using the Flower framework across three simulated nodes representing distinct fisheries sites, ensuring that any observed performance difference reflects the federated training process itself rather than a difference in model capacity. The centralised model achieved 94.75% accuracy, within half a percentage point of a calculated 94.73% theoretical noise ceiling derived from the dataset’s own noise model, while the federated model achieved a comparable 94.8-95.0% accuracy across five training rounds. A STRIDE-based threat analysis identified nine cybersecurity threats affecting the system, of which the highest-severity communication threat was mitigated using Transport Layer Security (TLS), implemented and empirically measured to add negligible computational overhead. Permutation-based feature importance analysis further identified exposure duration, rather than temperature, as the dominant predictor of spoilage risk (74.48% relative contribution). These results demonstrate that federated learning’s privacy-preservation and connectivity-resilience benefits can be obtained at negligible measurable cost to predictive accuracy, supporting federated architectures as a practically competitive, rather than purely privacy-motivated, choice for connectivity-constrained fisheries contexts in developing economies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对发展中国家小规模渔业收获后腐败损失（25-30%）问题，提出一种噪声感知的 Federated Learning（FL）框架用于鱼类腐败风险预测，并采用相同 MLP 架构在三个模拟渔业节点上与集中式基线进行架构控制对比。基于合成数据集（10,000 条记录，校准至 DHT22 传感器容差）的评估显示，集中式模型准确率 94.75%，接近理论噪声上限 94.73%，联邦模型准确率相当（94.8-95.0%）。基于 STRIDE 的威胁分析识别出九类网络安全威胁，最高危通信威胁经 TLS 缓解且计算开销可忽略；置换特征重要性分析表明暴露时长而非温度为腐败风险的主导预测因子（相对贡献 74.48%）。结果表明 FL 的隐私保护与连接韧性优势可在预测精度几乎无损的前提下实现，支持其作为连接受限渔业场景中实用且有竞争力的架构选择。

papers.title: Optimal Fisheries Management Using Transferable Shares of a Convex Tax
papers.authors: Berglann, Helge; Bjørndal, Trond; Maynou, Francesc
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In this paper, we propose a fishery control scheme that happens to be first best in the context of a Gordon‐Schaefer model with asymmetric information about effort/harvesting costs. It is widely acknowledged that in the absence of regulations, competition between vessels leads to a competitive game wherein the outcome is inefficient. We introduce a management scheme that regulates the fishing industry through an individual convex tax on effort or on catches. The shares of this tax can be traded in a market, thus solving problems related to asymmetric information. This can be achieved since heterogeneous fishing firms are individually stimulated to solve the same optimality problem as a social planner would. We apply this model to the Northwest Mediterranean demersal fishery as a case study.
papers.summary_cn: 针对Gordon-Schaefer模型中努力/捕捞成本存在不对称信息的问题，提出一种基于可交易凸税份额的渔业管理方案，使异质性渔船个体激励与social planner最优解一致，从而实现first best。以西北地中海demersal fishery为案例进行了应用分析。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap: The Taiwan–Japan Fisheries Agreement and Its Implications for Bilateral Fisheries Governance Challenges and Regional Security
papers.authors: Chen, Wei‐Chung
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The East China Sea is one of the most politically contested maritime regions in Asia, where overlapping territorial claims, fisheries competition, and increasing maritime activities create persistent governance challenges. This study examines the governance role of the Taiwan–Japan Fisheries Agreement in shaping fisheries order in the southern East China Sea. Drawing on field interviews with fisheries stakeholders in Taiwan and Okinawa, together with policy documents and official statistics, the study analyzes how the institutional design and operational practices of the agreement function in a complex geopolitical environment. The findings show that the agreement has contributed significantly to stabilising fishing activities through the Taiwan–Japan Fisheries Commission, which serves as a bilateral institutional platform for regular consultations and expert‐level meetings where operational rules, fishing practices, and spatial arrangements are discussed and adjusted. Through this institutionalised dialogue, the two sides have gradually developed spatial governance arrangements that reduce operational conflicts between fishing fleets. However, the analysis also reveals that the current framework focuses primarily on conflict mitigation and operational coordination, while cooperation on fisheries resource management remains limited. In addition, evolving regional maritime security dynamics are introducing new governance challenges that extend beyond conventional fisheries management. The Taiwan–Japan Fisheries Agreement therefore illustrates a form of pragmatic maritime governance in disputed waters, demonstrating how functional cooperation can contribute to maintaining operational stability even in politically sensitive maritime areas.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于对台湾与冲绳渔业利益相关者的实地访谈、政策文件及官方统计，考察《台日渔业协议》在东海南部渔业秩序中的治理作用。研究发现，台日渔业委员会作为双边制度平台，通过定期磋商与专家会议调整作业规则与空间安排，有效减少了渔捞冲突、稳定了渔业活动。但该框架主要侧重于冲突缓解与作业协调，渔业资源管理合作仍有限，且区域海上安全态势演变正带来超越传统渔业管理的新治理挑战。

papers.title: FISHFINDER: Catching fish name mistakes in text
papers.authors: Zbinden, Zachery D
papers.abstract: Abstract In a sea of text, fish name mistakes are easy to miss. Latin binomials are easy to misspell, and taxonomic nomenclature is continuously revised as new phylogenetic evidence accumulates, creating a persistent disconnect between current taxonomy and the names used in the literature. For example, the eighth edition of Common and Scientific Names of Fishes from the United States, Canada, and Mexico introduced 850 changes to fish nomenclature. But no existing tool validates fish names in unstructured manuscript text against this authority. Therefore, I developed FISHFINDER, a free, easy-to-use web application that classifies scientific and common fish names by comparing them against the 5,086 species in the Names of Fishes, 8th edition and 8,729 synonyms compiled from Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes (https://researcharchive.calacademy.org/research/ichthyology/catalog/fishcatmain.asp). An analysis of synonym data revealed that species accumulate a mean of 1.7 synonyms (median = 1, max = 38), with 61% of species having at least one historical synonym that could appear in the literature. To quantify the prevalence of naming errors in recent literature, I applied the FISHFINDER classification engine to the body text of 38 papers whose study systems were verified to lie within the Names of Fishes area (the United States, Canada, and Mexico) and that used at least one scientific name. Of these, 42% contained at least one outdated synonym or misspelled species name: 29% used outdated synonyms and 29% contained misspellings. An additional 53% of papers referenced species whose names changed between the seventh and eighth editions. These findings demonstrate that nomenclatural errors are common and that automated validation tools can help authors, reviewers, and editors ensure taxonomic accuracy before publication. FISHFINDER is freely available at fishnames.net.
papers.summary_cn: 研究开发了免费网络工具FISHFINDER，通过比对《Names of Fishes》第8版（5,086种）及Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes（8,729个异名），对非结构化文本中的鱼类学名和俗名进行校验分类。异名分析显示每种平均积累1.7个异名（中位数1，最多38），61%的物种至少存在一个可能出现在文献中的历史异名。对38篇研究区域位于美加墨且使用学名的论文全文检测发现，42%含过时异名或拼写错误（各占29%），另有53%引用了第7至8版间发生名称变更的物种，表明命名错误普遍存在，自动化校验工具可辅助作者、审稿人和编辑在发表前确保分类学准确性。

papers.title: Typifying tiny teeth: A standardized coding system to quantify morphological variation in fish teeth for comparative ecological, evolutionary, and functional morphological studies
papers.authors: Sibert, Elizabeth C; Friedman, M; Gall, Morgan; Marion, Monica M; Rubin, Leah D; Mauro, Nicholas Wallis
papers.abstract: Abstract Teeth play a crucial role in vertebrate ecology as one of the main interfaces between predators and their prey. As the most diverse vertebrates on the planet, and the dominant vertebrate consumers in nearly all aquatic ecosystems, fishes – and their teeth – thus play an important role in evolutionary and ecological dynamics of aquatic systems. Most studies of fish tooth morphology, both extinct and extant, have focused on single or a few closely related taxa, rather than attempting to place those teeth in a wider, cross-taxa morphological framework. Further, these studies use disparate criteria to evaluate the morphological variation observed in the teeth specific to their study system, making comparison of fish teeth between studies and across taxa challenging, limiting efforts to understand large-scale patterns of fish tooth morphology. Thus, a common language and morphological framework is necessary to facilitate broader studies of tooth morphology. Here we present a morphometric character coding system that captures morphological variability, drawing on an extensive database of teeth including over 200,000 microfossils and over 800 extant fishes from 61 orders, sampling a wide diversity of fish teeth and their potential range of morphological diversity. The morphological code has been created to be easily replicable across sample and imaging mode, to facilitate direct comparison across studies and independent research teams. Further, the structure of the morphological code is such that additional character states and characters are easily added as new morphological diversity is observed. Finally, we include an R package, ichthyoliths, which executes tooth morphometric disparity analyses based off of the code described in this manuscript, as well as the denticle morphometric code outlined in in Rubin et al. (2025), and can be flexibly used and updated by any researcher who places their fish teeth onto the morphometric code, facilitating cross-study and cross-disciplinary collaborations. This comprehensive effort represents a significant step forward for standardizing the quantification of fish tooth morphology.
papers.summary_cn: 针对鱼类牙齿形态研究缺乏跨类群统一比较标准的问题，基于逾20万枚微体化石及61目800余种现生鱼类的牙齿数据库，构建了一套可标准化、可扩展的形态计量编码系统，适用于不同样本与成像模式，便于跨研究直接比较。该系统配套R包ichthyoliths，可执行牙齿形态差异分析，并支持研究者灵活更新编码，为鱼类牙齿的生态、演化与功能形态学研究提供了统一的量化框架。

papers.title: Fish Epigenetics: Molecular Mechanisms, Environmental Adaptation, and Emerging Computational Approaches
papers.authors: Molla, Mohammad Habibur Rahman; Abualreesh, Muyassar H.; Alqahtani, Mohammad Saeed Aljazza; Haridi, Alaa; Khayat, Mohammed F.; Jahan, Bushra; Islam, Md. Shafiqul
papers.abstract: Epigenetic regulation has transformed our understanding of how fish adapt to changing environments by modulating gene expression without altering the underlying DNA sequence. This review explores the “dark mastery” of fish epigenetics by providing mechanistic insights into the principal epigenetic processes, including DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin remodeling, and non-coding RNAs, that govern development, immunity, stress responses, and disease susceptibility. These regulatory mechanisms enable fish to respond dynamically to environmental stressors such as temperature fluctuations, salinity shifts, hypoxia, pollutants, ultraviolet radiation, and nutritional changes, thereby influencing physiological resilience, reproductive performance, and survival. Recent advances in next-generation sequencing and multi-omics technologies have substantially expanded our understanding of the fish epigenome, while bioinformatics has become indispensable for integrating and interpreting complex genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic datasets. Furthermore, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are emerging as powerful approaches for biomarker discovery, predictive modeling of disease susceptibility, environmental risk assessment, and precision aquaculture. The integration of epigenetics with bioinformatics and AI provides unprecedented opportunities to decipher complex regulatory networks, identify adaptive epigenetic signatures, and develop data-driven strategies for improving fish health and aquaculture sustainability. Despite these advances, important challenges remain, including limited species-specific epigenomic resources, difficulties in multi-omics integration, model interpretability, and the need for standardized analytical frameworks. This review highlights current knowledge, emerging computational approaches, and future perspectives for translating epigenetic discoveries into sustainable aquaculture practices and aquatic ecosystem conservation under accelerating environmental change.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了鱼类表观遗传学的主要分子机制（DNA methylation、histone modifications、chromatin remodeling及non-coding RNAs）及其在发育、免疫、应激响应和疾病易感性中的调控作用，重点阐述了这些机制如何介导鱼类对温度、盐度、低氧及污染物等环境胁迫的适应性响应。随着next-generation sequencing和多组学技术的发展，bioinformatics与AI/ML正成为表观遗传biomarker发现、疾病风险预测及精准水产养殖的重要工具。文章同时指出物种特异性表观基因组资源匮乏、多组学整合困难及分析框架标准化不足等挑战，并展望了表观遗传学在水产养殖可持续性与水生态系统保护中的应用前景。

papers.title: Buffering properties of fish aquafeeds: concepts, determinants and effects on physiology and growth
papers.authors: Márquez, Lorenzo; Hernández, Adrián J.; Azcuy, Rosendo L.; Ruiz, Nancy E.; Orellana, Paola; Larson, Majorie; Morales, Gabriel A.; Díaz, Manuel; Moyano, Francisco J.; Almansa, Eduardo
papers.abstract: The present paper is a comprehensive review of the existing literature on aquafeed acid binding capacity (ABC), and its effects on the digestive physiology, metabolism, intestinal microbiota, and growth of farmed fishes. ABC can be defined as the quantity of acid (usually HCl) required to reduce diet pH to a specified endpoint, typically 3.0 (ABC-3) or 4.0 (ABC-4). The ABC of a diet may influence the secretion pattern and minimum gastric pH, as well as the total amount of HCl secreted during digestion. On the other hand, the acidity of the gastric lumen plays a crucial role in the digestive processes of many cultured fish species, facilitating the activation of gastric proteases, the initial hydrolysis of dietary proteins, and the solubilization of mineral nutrients. As the secretion of gastric HCl entails energy expenditure, it is plausible that the fraction of the specific dynamic action (SDA, defined as the energetic costs due to food digestion and assimilation), associated with gastric digestion in fish could be modulated through dietary formulations and their corresponding ABC. In fish, available information suggests that a decrease in diet ABC can lead to a reduction in total specific dynamic action (SDA), while the effects on growth rates remain ambiguous or transitory. Modifications to diet ABC through supplementation with calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) may negatively impact growth rates due to a concomitant decrease in phosphorus digestibility rather than an increase in HCl secretion. Furthermore, when the costs of HCl secretion were examined using proton-pump inhibitors, such as omeprazole, both SDA values and durations decreased similarly, being this reduction directly correlated with diminished fish growth rates. Regarding the influence of dietary buffering properties on fish gut microbiota, from the few available studies it can be deduced that the effects are not very significative, but this could be just a consequence of the immaturity of the research on diet ABC and fish microbiota. Further research is warranted to determine whether the manipulation of dietary ABC can lead to enhanced growth rates and improved intestinal health in cultured fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了水产饲料酸结合力（ABC）的概念、决定因素及其对养殖鱼类消化生理、代谢、肠道微生物和生长的影响。ABC通常定义为将饲料pH降至3.0或4.0所需酸量，可影响胃酸分泌模式、最低胃pH及消化期HCl总分泌量，进而可能调节与胃消化相关的特定动力作用（SDA）。现有证据表明，降低饲料ABC可减少总SDA，但对生长率的影响尚不明确或仅为暂时性；通过添加CaCO₃提高ABC可能因降低磷消化率而抑制生长，而omeprazole抑制胃酸分泌则同时降低SDA与生长率。饲料缓冲特性对肠道微生物的影响尚不显著，可能与该领域研究尚不成熟有关，未来需进一步探究调控ABC能否改善养殖鱼类的生长与肠道健康。

papers.title: Analysis on benefit enhancement links for consumers and producers in abalone aquaculture
papers.authors: Lin, Zhenyi; Liu, Xinyu; Zhang, Lirong; Wang, Rui
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Economics and Policy Studies
papers.abstract: The abalone aquaculture industry in Dongshan County, Fujian Province, has achieved remarkable scale expansion, yet producers face rising costs and falling prices, while consumers struggle with quality uncertainty and price volatility. This paper systematically analyzes the breeding varieties, farming models, production processes, and market price fluctuations of Dongshan's abalone industry, identifying core contradictions between supply-side cost pressures and demand-side market segmentation. From the theoretical perspective of maximizing producer and consumer surplus, the study proposes six optimization pathways: seedling quality traceability, collective feed procurement and localized substitution, standardized farming management, graded pricing with diversified marketing channels, deep-processing as a market buffer, and regional price early-warning with emergency procurement mechanisms. The findings demonstrate that a coordinated industry-wide system for cost reduction, quality stabilization, and risk hedging can simultaneously improve producers' profit margins and consumers' value perception, fostering a mutually beneficial equilibrium and providing practical guidance for sustainable abalone aquaculture development.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以福建东山鲍鱼养殖产业为对象，分析其品种、养殖模式、生产流程及市场价格波动，识别供给侧成本压力与需求侧市场分割之间的核心矛盾。基于生产者与消费者剩余最大化理论，提出种苗质量溯源、饲料集中采购与本地化替代、标准化养殖管理、分级定价与多元营销、深加工市场缓冲、区域价格预警与应急采购六条优化路径。研究表明，产业协同的降本、稳质与风险对冲体系可同时提升生产者利润空间与消费者价值感知，为鲍鱼养殖可持续发展提供实践指导。

papers.title: Towards circularity in shellfish aquaculture: stimulating mussel shell dissolution in marine sediments
papers.authors: Goossens, Cedric; Bouillon, Steven; Meysman, Filip J. R.; van de Velde, Sebastiaan J.
papers.abstract: Ocean alkalinity enhancement (OAE) is receiving considerable attention as a carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) removal strategy, and novel approaches to increase the total alkalinity ( A T ) of the surface ocean are being explored. In bivalve aquaculture, calcification during shell growth consumes A T , thus leading to CO 2 emissions. After consumption, shells are typically landfilled or incinerated, which can generate additional CO 2 emissions. Here, we investigate how the CO 2 footprint of shellfish aquaculture can be reduced by using bivalve shells as a resource for mineral-based OAE. The idea is to grind the calcium carbonate (CaCO 3 ) shells to increase the reactive surface area and distribute them into permeable, oxygen-rich sediments, where their dissolution produces A T that could then compensate the CO 2 emitted during calcification. To evaluate this concept, we conducted microcosm incubations of sediments amended with crushed mussel shells (∼ 8 wt %), and monitored the sediment geochemistry and sediment-water exchange over 24 weeks. Control sediments exhibited low and constant CaCO 3 dissolution rates ( R diss = 0.9 ± 0.5 mmolm-2d-1) and A T fluxes ( F AT = 3.2 ± 1.1 mmolm-2d-1). In contrast, shell-amended sediments showed markedly higher R diss and F AT values, which exhibited a transient response modulated by oxygen and organic matter availability. Initially, shell dissolution was restricted, most likely by oxygen availability due to the intense mineralization of shell-associated organic matter. Subsequently, following gradual sediment reoxygenation, dissolution rates increased, reaching a maximum R diss of 22.7 ± 2.6 mmolm-2d-1 after 9 weeks, corresponding to a measured F AT of 43.0 ± 6.0 mmolm-2d-1. After that, CaCO 3 dissolution rates declined as organic matter availability decreased, approaching control rates, with a slightly elevated R diss of 2.2 ± 1.1 mmolm-2d-1 at the end of the experiment. After 24 weeks, ∼ 6 % of the initial shell mass had dissolved, and extrapolation of the dissolution rate at the end of the experiment suggests that complete dissolution would require ∼ 38 years. Our results suggest that organic matter availability limits CaCO 3 dissolution in the permeable sediment investigated. This constraint, however, can be alleviated by targeting environments with high organic matter deposition for in-situ applications, such as sediments beneath mussel farms, thereby promoting mussel aquaculture circularity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨将贻贝壳粉碎后施入透氧沉积物中以促进CaCO₃溶解，从而通过增强总碱度（A_T）抵消双壳类养殖钙化过程的CO₂排放。通过24周微宇宙培养实验监测沉积物地球化学及沉积物-水界面交换，发现添加壳粉（约8 wt%）的沉积物溶解速率和A_T通量显著高于对照，但受氧和有机质可利用性调控，初期受氧限制，复氧后R_diss最高达22.7 ± 2.6 mmol m⁻² d⁻¹，随后随有机质消耗而下降。24周后约6%初始壳质量溶解，推算完全溶解需约38年，表明有机质供给是限制CaCO₃溶解的关键因素，建议将原位应用靶向高有机质沉积环境（如贻贝养殖区下方沉积物）以促进养殖循环性。

papers.title: The R plasmid pRAS2 in the fish pathogen Aeromonas salmonicida is a global mediator of antibiotic resistance in aquaculture and can be used by pRAS3 for mobilization
papers.authors: Dahal, Surya Prasad; Munang’andu, Hetron Mweemba; Solberg, Asta; Sørum, Henning
papers.abstract: Horizontal gene transfer (HGT) mediated by conjugative plasmids is a major driver of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) dissemination in aquatic environments. In Aeromonas salmonicida , plasmid-mediated HGT is largely driven by the pRAS plasmid family. Here we present genomic and experimental characterization of pRAS2 from A. salmonicida strain 1682/92 and demonstrate its role in helper-dependent mobilization of the co-resident pRAS3. Whole genome sequencing (WGS) divided the pRAS2 backbone into three modules. Module A encodes replication, maintenance and inheritance stability functions, including transposase, resolvase, partitioning and antitoxin-associated genes. Module B encodes a canonical type IV secretion system (T4SS) conjugation module containing virB2 - virB6 , virB8 - virB11 and virD4 with virB2 and virB5 forming the transfer pilus. Module C encodes the resistance determinants sul2 , aph(6)-Id , neo and Tet 31. Modules A and B were organized as in plasmids of Vibrio alginolyticus , Edwardsiella piscicida and Piscirickettsia salmonis , indicating that pRAS2 shares a conserved backbone with plasmids of other aquatic bacteria, including fish pathogens isolated on different continents. Module C was the most variable region: sul2 and aph(6)-Id were shared with pEIB202 of E. piscicida , whereas the tetracycline resistance determinant remained the same, being Tet 31 in pRAS2 as well as in pEIB202, p3PS10 and p3PS11, but absent from pVb1978 ( Vibrio alginolyticus ), pVIM-20710 ( Enterobacter hormaechei ) and p4PS9. The pRAS3 plasmids of strains 1682/92 and 2131/90, used as donors in conjugation experiments with an Escherichia coli DH5α recipient, carried the same mobilization-associated (MOB) genes and the tetracycline resistance determinant Tet C. Transfer of pRAS3 occurred only from strain 1682/92, which carried both pRAS2 and pRAS3; no transconjugant colonies were recovered from strain 2131/90, which carried pRAS3 alone. WGS showed an identical organization of the MOB, tetA (C) and tetR (C) genes in the 1682/92 donor and its transconjugant, providing experimental evidence that pRAS2 functions as a conjugative helper plasmid mediating mobilization of pRAS3. Conjugation trials performed with these strains between 1993 and 1995 further show that pRAS2 is self-transmissible, transferring autonomously at a frequency approximately three orders of magnitude higher than that of its co-mobilization of pRAS3. This demonstrates plasmid-plasmid cooperation within the pRAS plasmid family as a mechanism supporting the spread of AMR genes in aquatic bacterial communities.
papers.summary_cn: 研究对杀鲑气单胞菌（Aeromonas salmonicida）1682/92菌株中的R质粒pRAS2进行了基因组与实验表征，揭示其在共居质粒pRAS3 mobilization中的helper功能。全基因组测序将pRAS2骨架分为三个模块：模块A（复制与稳定维持）、模块B（编码完整T4SS的接合模块）和模块C（携带sul2、aph(6)-Id、neo及Tet 31耐药决定簇），其中模块A和B与其他水生细菌（包括鱼类病原菌）质粒高度保守。接合实验证实，仅同时携带pRAS2和pRAS3的1682/92菌株可向E. coli DH5α转移pRAS3，且pRAS2自身接合转移频率比其介导pRAS3 mobilization的频率高约三个数量级，表明pRAS质粒家族内的质粒-质粒协作是水产养殖环境中AMR基因扩散的重要机制。

papers.title: Growth performance, physiological response, and economic viability of Anabas testudineus reared in an airlift biofloc aquaculture system
papers.authors: Hussain, J.; Prathib, P.S.; Sarma, D.; Singh, A.K.; Kima, V.
papers.abstract: Aim: The study evaluates the feasibility of an airlift biofloc aquaculture system (ABAS) by assessing the welfare parameters of Anabas testudineus (Bloch, 1792) and the economic analysis of the system. Methodology: The experiment was conducted for 90 days in 1500 litre capacity FRP tanks. The design included a control with six diffusion air stones and a treatment with six airlift pumps, each in triplicate. Growth, water quality, haematological parameters, antioxidant enzymes (superoxide dismutase and catalase), and stress indicators (cortisol and glucose) were evaluated. Economic performance was assessed using BEP, ROI, and BCR for A. testudineus culture in ABAS. Results: ABAS outperformed the diffusion-aerated biofloc system, achieving higher dissolved oxygen (6.4 mg l-1), biofloc volume (7.8 m l l-1), and growth, including specific growth rate (3.58% day-1), feed conversion ratio (0.95), weight gain (1931.5%), and biomass production (10.46 kg m-3). Lower haematological, antioxidant and stress indicators indicated reduced physiological and oxidative stress. Economic analysis showed greater profitability, with BEP (1.69 kg), ROI (68.75%) and BCR (1.69) than the control. Interpretation: Under the experimental conditions, ABAS improved the growth performance, water quality, stress-related biomarker responses, and economic returns compared with the control. These findings highlight its potential as a sustainable approach for A. testudineus culture. Key words: Aeration, Airlift pump, Anabas testudineus, Biofloc, Sludge management
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了气升式生物絮团养殖系统（ABAS）对攀鲈（Anabas testudineus）的养殖可行性，通过90天试验比较了气升泵与扩散气石两种增氧方式对生长、水质、血液生理指标及经济效益的影响。结果表明，ABAS组溶解氧（6.4 mg/L）、生物絮团体积（7.8 ml/L）及生长性能（SGR 3.58%/d、FCR 0.95、增重率1931.5%、生物量10.46 kg/m³）均优于对照组，且皮质醇、葡萄糖及抗氧化酶等应激指标更低。经济分析显示ABAS组BEP（1.69 kg）、ROI（68.75%）和BCR（1.69）均优于对照组，表明该系统可提升攀鲈养殖的生长、福利与盈利水平。

papers.title: Beyond warming: changes in copepod phenological timing in response to marine heatwaves before and during their blooms
papers.authors: Deschamps, Margot Marie; Boersma, Maarten; Giménez, Luis
papers.abstract: Introduction In marine ecosystems, copepods play an essential role in linking primary producers to higher trophic levels. As ectothermic organisms with short life cycles, they are particularly sensitive to environmental changes, because their metabolism and development are closely tied to abiotic conditions. Consequently, changes in environmental conditions, including temperature, can affect copepods and potentially lead to phenological shifts that may disrupt entire food webs. Whilst such shifts have been linked to global warming, the specific impact of marine heatwaves (MHWs) on copepod phenology remains unclear. Methods We used the Helgoland Roads long-term time series (German Bight, North Sea), one of the world’s richest marine datasets, to examine changes in the phenological timing of key copepod taxa in response to MHWs. We computed yearly bloom traits using an algorithm adapted from phytoplankton bloom analyses and assessed their relationships with MHW components (i.e., mean temperature intensity, proportion of MHW days, maximum temperature decline rate and maximum temperature increase rate) both before and during the bloom. Results With the exception of the calanoid copepod Acartia spp., we found no evidence of consistent phenological shifts in response to MHW components occurring before the bloom. However, MHWs occurring during copepod blooms led to significant changes in bloom duration. For most taxa, bloom duration decreased (contraction) with increasing proportion of MHW days (relative to the bloom duration) and with faster rates of temperatures increase within the bloom. Interestingly, during their blooms, copepods experienced increases in both mean and variance of proportion of MHW days and temperature intensity over the time, suggesting a shift in selective pressure linked to MHW exposure patterns. Discussion These findings highlight the complex influence of MHWs on copepod phenology and the potential consequences for marine food webs, including mismatches with fish larvae that may affect fish recruitment. Understanding these dynamics is crucial, as MHWs are expected to intensify in duration, frequency, and magnitude in future climates.
papers.summary_cn: 基于Helgoland Roads长期时间序列，研究了marine heatwaves（MHWs）对关键桡足类物候时序的影响，分别考察了bloom前和bloom期间MHW各分量（平均温度强度、MHW天数比例、最大升温/降温速率）与bloom特征的关系。结果显示，除Acartia spp.外，bloom前的MHW未引发一致的物候位移，但bloom期间发生的MHW显著缩短了多数类群的bloom持续时间，且MHW天数比例越高、升温速率越快，收缩越明显。桡足类在bloom期间经历的MHW暴露比例和温度强度的均值与方差均随时间增加，提示选择压力发生转变，并可能通过食物网错配影响鱼类补充量。

papers.title: Seawater sprinkling promotes swim bladder inflation and reduces lordosis during mass-scale seed production in the leopard coral grouper Plectropomus leopardus
papers.authors: Fujikura, Yuji; Takeuchi, Hiroyuki; Yamaguchi, Tomofumi; Sanda, Tetsuya; Miyoshi, Kaho; Uji, Susumu
papers.abstract: Abstract Lordosis caused by failed swim bladder inflation (SBI) is a major constraint on the production of Plectropomus leopardus . During seed production, an oil film applied to prevent surface trapping impedes air gulping and hinders SBI. We developed a full-surface seawater sprinkling method and evaluated its effects on SBI and survival. In a descriptive preliminary comparison of four oil-film removal methods (one tank each), the sprinkler treatment appeared promising, with SBI and survival rates of 53.6% and 71.4% at 9 days after hatching (DAH), and was therefore scaled up to 10 sprinklers in Experiment 1. During 5–10 DAH, the SBI rate was significantly higher in the sprinkler treatment than in the control with no oil-film removal (51.3% versus 1.3%; 50.0 pp), whereas survival did not differ significantly. At 138 DAH, the incidence of lordosis was significantly lower in the sprinkler treatment (8.5%) than in the control (61.0%; 52.5 pp). In Experiment 2, the SBI rate was 64.0% with 10 sprinklers and 46.0% with four (18.1 pp), and the difference was not significant. Thus, seawater sprinkling promotes SBI without a detectable reduction in survival and offers a practical approach for suppressing lordosis during grouper seed production.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对豹纹鳃棘鲈（Plectropomus leopardus）种苗生产中因 swim bladder inflation（SBI）失败导致脊柱前凸（lordosis）的问题，开发了全表面海水喷淋法以去除水面油膜、促进仔鱼吞气。初步比较四种油膜去除方法后，将喷淋法扩大至10个喷头进行验证：5–10 DAH期间喷淋组SBI率显著高于未去除油膜的对照组（51.3% vs 1.3%），而存活率无显著差异；至138 DAH时喷淋组lordosis发生率显著降低（8.5% vs 61.0%）。实验2中10喷头与4喷头的SBI率分别为64.0%和46.0%，差异不显著。结果表明，海水喷淋可有效促进SBI并在不降低存活率的前提下抑制石斑鱼种苗生产中的lordosis。

papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了挪威峡湾冷水竹节珊瑚 *Isidella lofotensis* 在鲑鱼养殖场附近与对照点的存活与健康状况，以评估网箱养殖的底栖影响。结果显示养殖场导致该珊瑚出现致死与亚致死损伤，表明鱼类养殖对冷水珊瑚群落具有显著负面生态效应。

papers.title: Thermal performance of juvenile American lobsters (Homarus americanus) from different Eastern Canadian locations
papers.authors: Drolet, David; Riley, Cyrena; Estrada, Rafael; Robert, Sonia; Savard, Laurie; Small, Daniel
papers.abstract: Using a novel laboratory system, we exposed early benthic juvenile American lobsters (Homarus americanus), raised from ovigerous females coming from three Eastern Canadian locations, to 15 temperatures (5-28°C) and followed their development for approximately four months. We calibrated thermal performance curves (TPCs) for survival and growth rate, and the relationships were well described by Weibull functions with an exponential increase from 5 to ~16 °C, a levelling-off before the thermal optimum of ~21°C and a rapid decline above the optimum; no individual survived to the end of the experiment above 26 °C. No regional thermal adaptation was detected as the TPCs were similar among locations despite their summer temperatures varying by ~10°C. Finally, molt frequency and molt carapace length increment were also well described by Weibull functions with gradual increases in rate until the optimum (22.7 and 20.7°C, respectively), followed by mild decreases beyond the optimum. These results could serve as an important component of future modeling approaches to incorporate the effect of temperature in the population dynamics of the most important commercial marine species in North America.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以源自加拿大东部三个地点的抱卵雌性美洲螯龙虾（Homarus americanus）所孵化的早期底栖幼体为对象，在实验室新型系统中设置15个温度梯度（5–28°C）并追踪约四个月，校准了存活与生长速率的thermal performance curves（TPCs）。结果显示TPCs可由Weibull函数良好描述，5至约16°C呈指数上升，约21°C热最适前趋于平台，超过最适后迅速下降，26°C以上无个体存活至实验结束；尽管各地夏季水温相差约10°C，TPCs在地区间无显著差异，未检测到区域性thermal adaptation。蜕壳频率与蜕壳甲壳长度增量同样符合Weibull函数，最适温度分别为22.7°C和20.7°C。该结果为将温度效应纳入北美最重要商业海产物种population dynamics建模提供了关键参数。

papers.title: Long-term decline in egg size of Japanese hatchery chum salmon links to declines in return rate and abundance
papers.authors: Kitada, Shuichi
papers.abstract: Variation in life-history traits contributes to fitness and population productivity in salmonids. To investigate long-term changes in egg size and body size of Japanese hatchery chum salmon and their links to declines in return rate and abundance, I analyzed egg size and female fork length (FL) of approximately 21,000 age-4 and age-5 fish from 13 hatchery-enhanced rivers in Japan during 1999–2019. River-specific generalized additive models (GAMs) identified synchronous declines in egg size across most rivers. Hierarchical GAMs adjusting for female FL, age, and river effects revealed a nationwide decline in egg size, whereas adjusted FL showed pronounced interannual variation without a long-term decline. Mean age at return also declined after approximately 2010 because of shifts in age composition. Standardized exponential decay rates were remarkably similar for egg size, return rate, and chum salmon abundance, suggesting common underlying environmental and evolutionary processes. These findings suggest that long-term declines in maternal investment may have contributed to declining return rates and abundance, underscoring the importance of life-history traits in evaluating the long-term consequences of hatchery enhancement programs.
papers.summary_cn: 日本孵化场增强的 chum salmon 卵径在1999–2019年间于多数河流同步下降；基于约21,000尾4龄和5龄鱼的 hierarchical GAM 分析显示，校正雌鱼 fork length、年龄和河流效应后全国尺度卵径仍显著下降，而校正叉长无长期趋势，回归年龄约2010年后亦下降。卵径、return rate 与丰度的标准化指数衰减率高度相似，提示共同的环境与进化过程。研究表明母体投入的长期下降可能促成 return rate 和丰度下降，强调 life-history traits 在评估孵化场增强项目长期后果中的重要性。

papers.authors: Parmentier, Bram; Brasseur, Sophie; Couperus, Bram; Immler, Eva; van Langevelde, Frank; Perdon, Jack; Schultz, Jana Tabea; Tulp, Ingrid; Witbaard, Rob; van Zwol, Jetze
