papers.title: Aspects of the Fisheries of Multi-day boats operated from the Galle Fishery Harbour, South Coast of Sri Lanka, with Particular Emphasis on Flotsam-Associated Ring-netting
papers.authors: Prabhani, K. G. M.; Perera, H. A. C. C.
papers.journal: Sri Lanka Journal of Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: This study examines various aspects of the flotsam-associated ring-net (“Kandan Coarse”) fishery at Galle fishery harbour, Sri Lanka. Data were collected from 98 randomly sampled multiday boats between September 2021 and June 2022. Boats were categorized as operating ring-net only, drift gillnet or longline only, or a combination of ring-net and drift gillnet/longline. Ring-net-only landings were most common (87%) and contributed 84% of the total monthly catch. The catch comprised 16 fish species from eight families: Carangidae, Scombridae, Coryphaenidae, Balistidae, Monocanthidae, Lobatidae, Kyphosidae and Ephippidae. The mean total lengths of Decapterus russelli (29.3 ± 0.90 cm), Canthidermis maculata (30.6 ± 0.36 cm) and Auxis thazard (32.1 ± 2.53 cm) exceeded the reported lengths at first maturity and represented 69% of ring-net production. Thunnus albacares dominated longline catches, whereas Katsuwonus pelamis dominated drift-gillnet catches. Mean total lengths of T. albacares (137.0 ± 10.36 cm) and K. pelamis (54.82 ± 1.73 cm) caught by longline/drift gillnet were significantly higher (p < 0.05) than those caught by ring-net (41.3 ± 3.12 cm and 39.8 ± 3.85 cm, respectively). Both values exceeded the lengths at first maturity, whereas ring-net catches did not. CPUE was significantly higher (p < 0.05) for boats using ring-net plus drift gillnet/longline (26.38 kg boat⁻¹ day⁻¹) than for drift gillnet/longline-only (10.77 kg boat⁻¹ day⁻¹) and ring-net-only operations (6.02 kg boat⁻¹ day⁻¹). The highest mean income was recorded for ring-net-only operations (1.867 ± 0.327 million LKR), while the lowest occurred in drift-gillnet/longline-only operations (0.807 ± 0.470 million LKR). No significant difference was observed among mean operating costs. These findings provide an initial basis for sustainable management of the ring-net fishery, particularly for migratory tuna species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2021年9月至2022年6月在斯里兰卡Galle渔港对98艘multi-day boats的随机采样，分析了与flotsam-associated ring-net（"Kandan Coarse"）作业相关的渔业特征。ring-net-only作业最为普遍（87%），贡献了84%的月度总产量，主要渔获为Decapterus russelli、Canthidermis maculata和Auxis thazard，其平均全长均超过初次性成熟体长。长线和流刺网渔获的Thunnus albacares和Katsuwonus pelamis平均体长显著大于ring-net渔获，且ring-net渔获未达性成熟体长。ring-net与流刺网/长线组合作业的CPUE最高（26.38 kg boat⁻¹ day⁻¹），但ring-net-only作业收入最高。研究为ring-net渔业的可持续管理，尤其是对洄游性tuna species的管理提供了初步依据。

papers.title: Vaccines and integrated prevention in aquaculture (Part 2)
papers.authors: Manoyan, M. G.; Ivanova, A. N.; Panin, A. N.; Ivanov, A. V.
papers.abstract: The second part of this review addresses current approaches to specific immunoprophylaxis and the design of integrated programs for preventing infectious diseases in fish. Major vaccine platforms used or investigated in aquaculture are systematized, including inactivated, live attenuated, subunit, recombinant, DNA, RNA, vector-based and mucosal vaccines. Bacterial and viral targets are analyzed together with experimental strategies aimed at Saprolegnia parasitica and Aphanomyces invadans. Injection, immersion and oral delivery routes are discussed, as well as adjuvants, nanoparticles and biological antigen-delivery systems. Particular attention is given to probiotics as immunological and technological partners of vaccination, including pre-vaccination conditioning, post-vaccination support, probiotic microorganisms as antigen carriers, and combined seasonal prevention schemes. Safety requirements, regulatory considerations and evidence-based assessment are reviewed. A practical model of integrated prevention is presented, combining risk audit, diagnostics, biosecurity, vaccination, microbiota management, nutrition and outcome monitoring. The analysis shows that the strongest preventive effect is achieved not by opposing vaccines and probiotics, but by integrating pathogen-specific immunization with microbiota-oriented and technology-based interventions tailored to the production system.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述水产养殖中特异性免疫预防及integrated prevention方案的设计，系统梳理了灭活、减毒、亚单位、重组、DNA、RNA、载体及黏膜等疫苗平台，涵盖细菌、病毒及Saprolegnia parasitica和Aphanomyces invadans等靶标，并讨论了注射、浸泡和口服等接种途径及佐剂、纳米颗粒和生物抗原递送系统。重点分析了probiotics作为疫苗接种的免疫学与技术伙伴在接种前调理、接种后支持、抗原载体及季节性联合预防方案中的作用。研究提出整合风险审计、诊断、biosecurity、疫苗接种、microbiota管理、营养和效果监测的实用模型，认为最强预防效果来自病原特异性免疫与microbiota导向及技术干预的整合，而非疫苗与probiotics的对立。

papers.title: Social–ecological vulnerability and adaptive capacity in data-poor artisanal fisheries: integrating local ecological knowledge and socioeconomic indicators
papers.authors: Pérez, Heydi; Paramo, Jorge; Berrio, Jahir; Pérez, Emelin
papers.abstract: Small-scale fisheries are complex social–ecological systems in which environmental change interacts with socioeconomic constraints, shaping the vulnerability of fishing-dependent communities. This study assessed socioeconomic vulnerability and fishers’ perceptions across 12 artisanal fishing communities along the marine–coastal margin of the Magdalena Department, Colombian Caribbean. Socioeconomic information and local ecological knowledge were obtained through structured interviews with 246 active fishers. A Socioeconomic Vulnerability Index (SEVI) was developed using three complementary indicators representing economic resources, human capital, and livelihood sensitivity: total income, education level, and fishing dependence. Fishers’ perceptions of environmental and governance pressures were analyzed using lexical analysis and Descending Hierarchical Classification. The SEVI revealed marked spatial differences in relative socioeconomic vulnerability, with community mean values ranging from 0.549 to 0.776. Tasajera, Don Diego, La Poza, Salguero Beach, and Achotes showed high relative vulnerability, whereas the remaining communities showed moderate vulnerability. Fishing dependence ranged from 0.425 to 0.669 but did not correspond directly to overall SEVI rankings, emphasizing the multidimensional nature of socioeconomic vulnerability. Sensitivity analysis showed that community rankings were insensitive to normalization procedure but more responsive to weighting assumptions. Leave-one-out analysis further indicated that community rankings were particularly sensitive to the inclusion of education, highlighting the distinctive contribution of human capital to differences among communities. Fishers identified overexploitation, pollution, fishing pressure, climate variability, and institutional limitations as major perceived challenges affecting artisanal fisheries. Integrating socioeconomic indicators with local ecological knowledge provides a practical framework for identifying relative vulnerability patterns and supporting place-based, adaptive fisheries governance in data-poor coastal social–ecological systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对哥伦比亚加勒比海Magdalena省12个手工渔业社区，通过246名渔民的结构化访谈获取社会经济信息与local ecological knowledge，构建了由总收入、教育水平和渔业依赖度三项指标组成的社会经济脆弱性指数（SEVI）。结果显示社区间相对脆弱性差异明显（均值0.549–0.776），但渔业依赖度与SEVI排名并不直接对应，体现脆弱性的多维性；敏感性分析表明排名对归一化方法不敏感、对权重假设较敏感，且对教育指标的纳入尤为敏感。渔民感知的主要压力包括过度捕捞、污染、捕捞压力、气候变异和制度局限。研究表明，将社会经济指标与local ecological knowledge整合，可为data-poor沿海社会—生态系统的适应性渔业治理提供实用框架。

papers.title: Energy savings in Mediterranean demersal trawl fisheries: full and model scale comparison of experimental and conventional gears on drag and fuel consumption
papers.authors: Martino, Ilaria; Li Veli, Daniel; Petetta, Andrea; Vianson, Giorgio; Herrmann, Bent; Cacciamani, Roberto; Lucchetti, Alessandro; Sala, Antonello; Jafarzadeh, Sepideh; Huda, Nurul
papers.abstract: Introduction Reducing fuel consumption, hydrodynamic drag and seabed impact without compromising catch performance and size selectivity remains a key challenge for demersal trawl fisheries. This study presents a comparison of demersal trawl configurations designed to reduce energy demand and improve the environmental performance of a Mediterranean bottom trawl fishery. Methods The analysis focused on two configurations of the four-panel otter trawl design known as the “Americana”: a traditional commercial configuration and a newly optimised experimental design developed through targeted modifications in mesh size distribution, netting material and belly geometry. The two gears were first evaluated through flume-tank trials using 1:10 scale models. These tests showed that the experimental trawl achieved a wider horizontal geometry and substantially lower towing load than the traditional design, supporting the expected reduction in drag associated with the decrease in twine surface area and projected resistance. Full-scale sea trials were then conducted in the central Adriatic Sea, Italy, under comparable operational conditions. A total of 19 comparative hauls were carried out, alternating between the traditional and experimental configurations. Fuel consumption, vessel speed, towing loads at the winch and wing-ends, net geometry and GPS data were collected using a harmonised instrumentation system. Catch data were also recorded to assess changes in fishing performance, catch composition and size-dependent catch efficiency. A dedicated lift test was used to derive a vessel-specific speed -fuel consumption model and to partition total fuel use during towing into vessel-related and gear-related components. Results and conclusions Compared with the traditional gear, the experimental trawl showed greater horizontal net spread and markedly reduced vertical opening. These changes resulted in a 26.7% reduction in hydrodynamic drag and a 15% decrease in fuel consumption during towing. When fuel use was partitioned, gear-related fuel demand showed an even larger relative reduction of 29.7%. Total catch rates did not differ significantly between gear configurations. Catch comparison analyses indicated species-specific responses, with higher catch efficiency for pelagic and semi-pelagic species and reduced retention of smaller individuals for some demersal species. Overall, the results demonstrate that targeted trawl modifications can improve energy efficiency and potentially reduce seabed interaction while maintaining commercially acceptable catch performance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对地中海底层拖网渔业，通过调整网目分布、网衣材料和网腹几何形状，设计了一种基于四片式“Americana”拖网的低能耗实验性网具，并与传统商业网具进行对比。先以1:10比例模型开展水槽试验，随后在亚得里亚海中部进行19次全尺度海上对比拖曳，同步采集燃油消耗、拖曳载荷、网具几何形态及渔获数据。结果显示，实验网具水平扩张更大、垂直开口明显减小，水动力阻力降低26.7%，拖曳燃油消耗下降15%，其中网具相关燃油需求降幅达29.7%；总渔获率无显著差异，但中上层及半中上层鱼种捕获效率提高，部分底层鱼种的小个体留存量减少。

papers.title: Editorial: Encountering Maritime Northern Australia: perspectives on Sea Country, Fisheries, and Livelihoods
papers.authors: Stacey, Natasha; McKenna, Kylie
papers.abstract: Abstract This editorial introduces the Topical Collection Encountering Maritime Northern Australia: Perspectives on Sea Country, Fisheries and Livelihoods which brings together interdisciplinary research examining the social, cultural, economic and policy dimensions of maritime society in Northern Australia with a particular focus on the Northern Territory. The contributing papers explore enduring and emerging issues in a region where competing values and interests in the ocean exist and intersect with environmental change, evolving policy regimes and Indigenous rights and self-determination in Sea Country. Collectively the papers showcase diverse social science approaches and frameworks while emphasising the value of collaborative, contextualised, and community-based research. Contributions address gaps in understanding the history and current roles and values of women in fisheries, livelihood maritime mobility in the Arafura and Timor Seas through transboundary fishing and contemporary Indigenous culture, and the contribution of diverse knowledge systems for science and marine management. The Collection also responds to the paucity of social science research about the regions’ diverse commercial, Indigenous and recreational fisheries livelihoods and enterprises. Together these studies support future decision-making for sustainable marine livelihoods, equity and the generation of benefits for fishers, families and communities in the region.
papers.summary_cn: 该社论介绍了“Encountering Maritime Northern Australia”专题合集，聚焦澳大利亚北部（尤其是北领地）海洋社会的社会、文化、经济与政策维度，探讨海洋价值冲突、环境变化、政策演变及Indigenous rights与Sea Country自决等议题。合集涵盖女性在渔业中的历史与当代角色、Arafura和Timor海域跨境捕捞与Indigenous文化驱动的生计流动，以及多元知识体系对海洋科学管理的贡献。研究强调协作式、情境化与社区参与的社会科学方法，旨在弥补该区域商业、Indigenous及休闲渔业生计研究不足，为可持续海洋生计与公平决策提供支撑。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Review on Dried Fish Processing and Marketing in Bangladesh: Challenges, Opportunities, and SustainabilityA Comprehensive Review on Dried Fish Processing and Marketing in Bangladesh: Challenges, Opportunities, and Sustainability
papers.authors: Parvin, Shahanaj; Dey, Shishir Kumar; Nisheeth, Nazia Naheen; Alam, Mezbabul; Sharmin, Sonia
papers.abstract: Dried fish remains an important shelf-stable food, livelihood product and trading commodity in Bangladesh, yet the sector is characterised by marked heterogeneity in processing conditions, food-safety performance, market organisation and access to upgrading technologies. This critical narrative review integrates evidence on production systems, drying and storage technologies, nutritional and microbiological quality, chemical hazards, value chains, livelihoods, regulation and sustainability. English-language literature published from 1 January 2000 to 5 July 2026 was identified through multidisciplinary and fisheries-, food- and health-relevant scholarly sources, supplemented by citation searching and authoritative institutional materials. The evidence indicates that traditional open sun drying persists because it is inexpensive, flexible and compatible with dispersed small-scale production, but product quality is vulnerable to humidity, insects, dust, uneven drying, handling and inadequate storage. Solar tunnel, chimney and covered drying systems can improve process protection and drying control under experimental or field conditions, although evidence for sustained adoption, profitability and maintenance at scale is substantially weaker than evidence for technical efficacy. Bangladesh studies report considerable variation in proximate composition, microbial contamination, pesticide residues and toxic metals. These findings justify stronger hazard-based quality assurance, but most studies are geographically local and cross-sectional, so they do not support a single national estimate of risk. Marketing studies consistently describe fragmented chains, limited working capital, storage and information constraints, and unequal value capture, while women contribute substantially to labour-intensive processing but often have less control over higher-value functions. Sustainability therefore cannot be reduced to dryer efficiency alone. It requires integrated attention to post-harvest loss, raw-material stewardship, climate resilience, safe processing, traceability, finance, labour conditions and market incentives. Future research should prioritise longitudinal, multi-site evaluations of technology adoption, representative surveillance of contaminants and microbiology, value-chain cost and margin analysis, and measurable social and environmental outcomes.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了孟加拉国干鱼加工与营销的生产体系、干燥贮藏技术、营养与微生物品质、化学危害、价值链、生计、法规及可持续性，文献覆盖2000—2026年。研究发现，传统露天晒干因成本低、灵活且适配分散小规模生产而持续主导，但品质易受湿度、昆虫、灰尘及贮藏条件影响；太阳能隧道、烟囱及覆盖式干燥系统在试验或田间条件下可改善干燥控制，但其规模化采纳、盈利性与维护证据明显不足。孟加拉国各地产品在近似组成、微生物污染、农药残留及有毒金属方面差异显著，营销链碎片化、资金与信息受限、价值分配不均，女性承担大量加工劳动却较少掌控高价值环节。可持续性需综合关注采后损失、原料管理、气候韧性、安全加工、可追溯性、融资、劳动条件与市场激励，未来应优先开展纵向多站点技术采纳评估、代表性污染物与微生物监测及价值链成本利润分析。

papers.title: A national fish pond dataset for Nigeria generated using automated detection and segmentation
papers.authors: Acero-Cuellar, Tatiana; Ayinde, Rodiat; Uponi, John; Khan, Bhoktear; Adeluyi, Oluwaseun; Alabi, Tunrayo; Olayide, Olawale; Gephart, Jessica A.; Bianco, Federica B.; Davis, Kyle Frankel
papers.summary_cn: 该研究构建了尼日利亚全国鱼塘数据集，采用自动化检测与分割技术识别鱼塘空间分布。

papers.title: Effect of Time–Temperature Modulation Combined with Residual Heating on Flavor and Texture Attributes of Steamed Perch Fish
papers.authors: Yang, Yaling; Wang, Lijin; Zhu, Feng; Song, Huanlu; Wang, Yanbo
papers.abstract: To optimize the steaming process parameters for perch fish and improve its flavor quality, this study systematically compared dual-stage steaming (low–high temperature and high–low temperature) and residual-heat steaming (dual-stage steaming followed by heat retention) with traditional single-stage steaming. Dual-stage steaming (especially 80 °C → 100 °C) produced significant treatment effects in texture and umami-related measures, while several volatile aroma compounds showed significant treatment effects (p < 0.05) and had higher measured concentrations under residual-heat steaming. Comparing dual-stage steaming modes (80 °C → 100 °C and 100 °C → 80 °C), the overall quality of perch fish was better when its core temperature underwent the main heating phase in the high-temperature stage. PCA comprehensive evaluation assigned the highest descriptive score (0.52) to DS 100(55)-80(75)-RH after considering texture, taste, and aroma characteristics; this ranking was not an inferential significance test. These laboratory-scale findings provide a basis for further optimization of steaming conditions for perch fish, but larger-scale validation is required before practical implementation.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了双阶段蒸制（低温→高温、高温→低温）与余热保温蒸制对鲈鱼风味和质构的影响，并与传统单阶段蒸制进行对照。双阶段蒸制（尤其80 °C→100 °C）对质构和鲜味指标影响显著，余热蒸制下多种挥发性香气化合物浓度更高。PCA综合评价显示，核心温度主要加热阶段处于高温的DS 100(55)-80(75)-RH得分最高（0.52），但该结果为描述性排序而非推断性检验，尚需放大规模验证。

papers.title: An underwater precision fish counting framework using transformer with feature offset aggregation and occlusion-aware attention in aquaculture
papers.authors: Gu, Tongtong; Wu, Zhengmeng; Li, Dashe; Sun, Mingyu
papers.journal: Journal of King Saud University Computer and Information Sciences
papers.summary_cn: 该研究面向水产养殖场景，提出一种基于Transformer的水下精准鱼类计数框架，融合特征偏移聚合与遮挡感知注意力机制，以应对水下图像中鱼体遮挡和特征偏移对计数精度的干扰。

papers.title: Under pressure: Use of hyperbaric chamber therapy for management of dissolved gas disorders in fish—15 cases (2015–2025)
papers.authors: Anton, Brian J; Smith, Andrew L; Diaz Bujan, Jesus; Allbaugh, Rachel A; Goodall, Anne; Krol, Lana; Dunker, Freeland H
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Our objective was to describe clinical findings, treatment protocols, and outcomes in captive fish presenting with ocular and/or buoyancy disorders attributed to dissolved gas disease undergoing novel treatment with hyperbaric therapy. Methods Electronic medical records were reviewed for 15 teleost fish comprising 10 species housed at a public aquarium and treated between 2015 and 2025 with hyperbaric chamber therapy for exophthalmos (n = 8), intraocular gas (n = 5), buphthalmos (n = 5), and/or positive buoyancy (n = 7). The collected data included diagnostics, adjunctive therapies, hyperbaric chamber course and parameters, response to treatment, recurrence, and postmortem findings when available. Results Initial clinical improvement in response to hyperbaric therapy was documented in 10 (67%) of the 15 fish, with long-term resolution (1 month: n = 1; 5 months: n = 1; &gt;18 months: n = 5) of clinical signs observed in 7 (47%) of the 15 fish. Three fish (21%) died during chamber treatment. Necropsy and histopathology identified infectious comorbidities in multiple nonresponders (n = 6). Conclusions Hyperbaric chamber therapy was associated with meaningful short-term (instantaneous to &lt;12 h) clinical improvement in many fish, particularly those with ocular presentations. Recurrence and mortality were common, most often in cases with severe and/or comorbid disease. Hyperbaric therapy may be a viable modality for the treatment of dissolved gas disorders and warrants further investigation.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究回顾性分析了2015—2025年间某公共水族馆15尾硬骨鱼（10种）因溶解气体病（dissolved gas disease）出现眼球突出、眼内积气、牛眼及正浮力等症状后，采用高压氧舱治疗（hyperbaric chamber therapy）的临床资料、治疗方案及转归。结果显示，10尾（67%）出现短期临床改善，7尾（47%）实现长期症状消退，3尾（21%）在治疗中死亡，复发和死亡多见于重症或合并感染病例。高压氧舱治疗对溶解气体病具有短期疗效，尤其对眼部症状者，但复发率和死亡率较高，其应用价值尚需进一步验证。

papers.title: Assessing hypoxia risk and ecological stability in reservoir-based aquaculture in the Wonorejo reservoir, Indonesia
papers.authors: Shafiya Rusydi, Haghiya; Rahardjo, Seto Sugianto Prabowo; Othman, Faridah; Fadjar, Mohamad; Dharmapriya, Thakshila Nadeeshani; Yuwanita, Rani; Pratiwi, Arum; Sholichin, Mohammad
papers.journal: Journal of Water and Land Development
papers.abstract: Sustainable aquaculture in inland reservoirs depends on seasonal hydrology, which influences nutrient dynamics and O2 availability. This study aimed to quantify O2 and nutrient-based ecological carrying capacity and seasonal hypoxia risk to support sustainable aquaculture planning. This study evaluated the feasibility and ecological capacity of aquaculture in the Wonorejo Reservoir, Indonesia, using a four-pillar framework: feasibility mapping, ecological assessment, carrying capacity estimation, and risk-based ecological management. Monthly water quality data from 2022–2024, supported by in situ validation in March 2025, were analysed using the Vollenweider phosphorus model, O2 balance calculations, total oxygen demand (TOD), and the ecological balance index (EBI). Spatial analysis identified areas suitable for aquaculture in about 36.2% of the area. Phosphorus loading remained within oligotrophic conditions (0.12–0.28 mg P∙m−2∙y−1), indicating that nutrient enrichment is not the dominant limiting factor. Oxygen availability emerged as the dominant ecological constraint under the applied O2 balance framework. Dry season elevated TOD relative to estimated natural re-aeration capacity. This resulted in chronic O2 deficits (EBI = 0.50–0.60) and reduced the system’s resilience. Under these O2-limited conditions, theoretical N-based aquaculture potential (1,250–1,600 mg∙y−1) declined to a sustainable range of 500–900 mg∙y−1. A hypoxia-focused hazard–exposure–vulnerability (HEV) assessment showed high HEV during dry seasons, moderate risk during transitional periods, and low risk during rainy conditions. The findings emphasise that O2 dynamics, rather than nutrient levels, govern sustainable aquaculture capacity. Oxygen-based stocking regulation, organic load management, aeration, and spatial zoning are recommended to improve ecological stability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印尼Wonorejo水库为对象，采用可行性制图、生态评估、carrying capacity估算与风险生态管理四支柱框架，结合2022—2024年逐月水质数据及2025年3月原位验证，量化基于O2与营养盐的生态承载力及季节性hypoxia风险。结果显示约36.2%水域适宜养殖，磷负荷处于oligotrophic水平（0.12–0.28 mg P∙m⁻²∙y⁻¹），营养盐并非主要限制因子；O2可利用性才是主导生态约束，旱季TOD超过自然复氧能力，导致慢性O2亏缺（EBI=0.50–0.60）并使理论N-based养殖潜力由1,250–1,600 mg∙y⁻¹降至500–900 mg∙y⁻¹。基于hypoxia的hazard–exposure–vulnerability评估表明旱季高风险、过渡期中等风险、雨季低风险，建议通过O2调控放养、有机负荷管理、增氧及空间分区提升生态稳定性。

papers.title: Effects of stocking size, density, and feeding frequency on growth performance of Centropristis striata in a recirculating aquaculture system
papers.authors: Chen, Yihao; Ying, Na; Gao, Li; Wu, Yanqing; Zhang, Bianbian; Song, Xuefeng; Chen, Yuguang; Chen, Jintao; Sui, Yanming; Qin, Bo
papers.abstract: Centropristis striata is a valuable marine fish native to the Atlantic coast of the United States and Mexico. In recent years, it has become an excellent species for promotion and breeding in the eastern and southeastern coastal areas of China. In order to explore the effects of different stocking size, stocking density and feeding frequency on the growth performance of C. striata , and to screen the optimal combination of culture parameters, and to provide a theoretical basis for aquaculture production practice, L 9 (3 3 ) experimental design was used to set up three factors and three levels of stocking size (200 g tail -1 , 400 g tail -1 , 600 g tail -1 ), stocking density (30 kg m -3 , 40 kg m -3 , 50 kg m -3 ) and feeding frequency (1,2,3 times day -1 ). A total of 9 experimental groups were set up, with 3 replicates per group. The test period was 8 weeks. The specific growth rate (SGR) and survival rate of each group were measured, and the results were analyzed using range and variance analyses. The results showed that the effects of the three factors on the survival rate were not significant, and the survival rate in each group was higher than 95%. Culture size and stocking density had a significant effect on the specific growth rate. As stocking size increased, the specific growth rate gradually decreased. With the increase of stocking density, the specific growth rate increased gradually, and the specific growth rate was the highest (0.45%) in the combination of 200 g tail -1 , 50 kg m -3 and 3 times day -1 . The range analysis showed that the primary and secondary order affecting the specific growth rate was: stocking size (R = 0.29) > breeding density (R = 0.10) > feeding frequency (R = 0.05). Based on the comprehensive growth performance, the optimal combination with the goal of rapid weight gain was 200 g tail -1 , 50 kg m -3 , feeding 3 times day -1 ; the optimal combination with high survival rate was 400 g tail -1 , 30 kg m -3 , feeding twice a day. This study can serve as a reference for parameter optimization in the industrial breeding of C. striata .
papers.summary_cn: 以黑鲷（*Centropristis striata*）为对象，采用L9(3³)正交设计在RAS中考察放养规格（200、400、600 g/尾）、放养密度（30、40、50 kg/m³）和投喂频率（1、2、3次/天）对生长性能的影响，试验周期8周。结果表明，三因素对存活率均无显著影响（各组均>95%），放养规格和密度对特定生长率（SGR）影响显著：SGR随规格增大而降低，随密度升高而升高。影响SGR的主次顺序为放养规格（R=0.29）>放养密度（R=0.10）>投喂频率（R=0.05）；以快速增重为目标的最优组合为200 g/尾、50 kg/m³、3次/天（SGR最高达0.45%），以高存活率为目标的最优组合为400 g/尾、30 kg/m³、2次/天。

papers.title: Oceanic Drivers of Expected Losses from the Creation of Large-Scale Marine Protected Areas in the Eastern Tropical Pacific Ocean on Commercial Tuna Fleets
papers.authors: Wu, Xiurou; Sanchirico, James N.
papers.abstract: There is growing recognition that to achieve ambitious international ocean conservation goals, the methods to develop protected areas and their socio-ecological impacts are as important as the designations themselves. Recent debates about closing large areas to fishing in the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean (ETPO) emphasize the need for rigorous tools to guide decision-making and clarify the contribution of specific locations to different fishing sectors under various oceanic conditions. Using a comprehensive and detailed dataset of industrial tuna fishing in the ETPO from 1997-2016, we estimate, with mixed effects models, the varied short-term economic impacts across vessel classes, fishing nations, and oceanic conditions resulting from two potential large-scale fishery closures. Our findings indicate that impacts differ significantly based on vessel size, fishing nation, species, and ocean temperature regime. Short-term losses in expected catch can reach 40 percent for some fleets but are typically around 10 percent. Our methods highlight the heterogeneity and variability in predicted impacts that could illuminate the political economy involved in siting large-scale marine protected areas in the ETPO and other locations.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于1997—2016年东热带太平洋（ETPO）工业金枪鱼渔业数据，采用混合效应模型评估两处潜在大规模禁渔区对商业金枪鱼船队的短期经济影响。结果显示，预期渔获损失因船型、船旗国、鱼种及海温状况而异，部分船队损失可达40%，但通常在10%左右。研究强调，预测影响的异质性与变异性可为ETPO及其他海域大型MPA选址的政治经济分析提供依据。

papers.title: Magnetic Deep Eutectic Solvent-Based Vortex-Assisted Liquid-Phase Microextraction for Mercury Determination in Seafood Samples
papers.authors: dos Santos de Assis, Rosivan; Santos, Luana Bastos; Santos, Márcio Souza; de Souza, Alexilda Oliveira; Lemos, Valfredo Azevedo
papers.abstract: Abstract This study aimed to develop and validate a vortex-assisted liquid-phase microextraction (VA-LPME) method based on a magnetic deep eutectic solvent (MDES) for the determination of mercury in seafood samples by cold vapor atomic absorption spectrometry (CV-AAS). The MDES was prepared from menthol and octanoic acid, and Fe 3 O 4 nanoparticles were incorporated to impart magnetic responsiveness, enabling rapid phase separation without centrifugation. Experimental conditions were optimized using a univariate approach, including DES composition (menthol:octanoic acid, 1:3), nanoparticle mass (75 mg Fe 3 O 4 ), agitation mode (vortex), extraction time (50 s), extraction solvent volume (100 µL), and pH (4.2). Under the optimized conditions, the proposed method achieved a detection limit of 0.09 µg L −1 and an enrichment factor of 51. Accuracy was confirmed by the analysis of certified reference materials, with measured values in good agreement with the certified values. The method was successfully applied to the determination of mercury in shellfish, sea bass, oyster, and crab samples, demonstrating its suitability for complex food matrices. The proposed procedure combines good analytical performance with low solvent consumption, simple operation, and a moderate green profile (AGREEprep = 0.54), supporting its potential for routine mercury monitoring in seafood.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发并验证了一种基于磁性低共熔溶剂（MDES）的涡旋辅助液相微萃取（VA-LPME）方法，结合冷蒸气原子吸收光谱法（CV-AAS）测定海产品中的汞。以薄荷醇与辛酸（1:3）制备MDES并掺入Fe₃O₄纳米颗粒实现磁性快速相分离，优化条件下检出限为0.09 µg L⁻¹，富集因子为51。该方法成功应用于贝类、海鲈、牡蛎和蟹等样品，具有溶剂消耗低、操作简便、绿色度适中（AGREEprep=0.54）等优点，适用于海产品汞的常规监测。

papers.title: Social context shapes acoustic signalling in the territorial damselfish Stegastes fuscus
papers.authors: Lessa, Aléxia A.; Barroso, Viviane; Xavier, Fábio C.; Ferreira, Carlos E. L.; Parmentier, Eric
papers.abstract: Abstract Acoustic communication plays an important role in social interactions in reef fishes, but how signals vary with behavioural context remains poorly understood for many species. We characterised the acoustic repertoire of the Brazilian damselfish Stegastes fuscus using synchronised underwater audio–video recordings and tested how sound features vary across social behaviours. Sounds were recorded during agonistic and courtship‐related interactions, and temporal and spectral acoustic parameters were measured to compare acoustic structure among contexts. Differences between behaviours were primarily found in temporal features: Courtship sounds were longer and contained more pulses than agonistic sounds. These results show that S. fuscus conveys social context mainly through modulation of temporal organisation rather than spectral properties. Our findings indicate that a single call type can be flexibly adjusted to signal behavioural context during territorial defence and courtship. By documenting the acoustic repertoire of a dominant territorial herbivore, this study highlights how social context structures sound production in damselfishes.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用水下音视频同步记录，表征了巴西雀鲷（*Stegastes fuscus*）的声学信号库，并检验其声音特征在争斗与求偶等社会情境中的变异。结果显示，不同行为情境下的声音差异主要体现在时间特征上：求偶声较争斗声更长、脉冲数更多，而频谱特征差异不明显。这表明该领域性植食性鱼类主要通过调节声音的时间结构而非频谱特性来传递社会情境信息，单一叫声类型可灵活调整以服务于领域防御和求偶。

papers.title: Frame and Catch Assessment Survey of the Fisheries in the Hadejia-Nguru Wetlands
papers.authors: Abubakar, Mohammad Mustapha
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF BIOLOGY AND GENETIC RESEARCH
papers.abstract: The fish resources of the Hadejia-Nguru wetlands(HNW) are extensive. This fishery survey was performed to estimate the fish catch, fishing effort, revenues of fishing and the occurrence of these at a particular period of time.Results obtained showed 31 fish landing sites were recorded with 683 fishermen operating, and a total of 173 canoes observed. Cast net is the most popular gear used in the wetland. An average of 2367 fishes are caught daily, with a mean weight of 1040.1kg. The cichlid fishes are the most abundant in terms of composition. The fisheries structure of HNW is generally primitive, highly artisanal with no single motorised boat. There was limited provision of fish handling and processing facilities. The sizes, number and weight of fish recorded in the wetland is highly encouraging for a developing fishery. While the 38 different species observed is higher than figures reported in other lakes in Nigeria. It was recommended that this frame survey be followed by a more extensive boat activity survey and landings survey in order to determine fishing effort, and catch composition. These surveys will contribute to better management of the fishery of HNW, as the government will be able to manage the wetland based on accurate data. This will enhance further improvement of facilities and services at landing sites by encouraging the State and Local Governments to consider fisheries activities as a revenue generating venture. As a result of which there will be more support for fisheries resources protection, development, research and sustainable management.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究对尼日利亚Hadejia-Nguru湿地（HNW）的渔业进行了frame survey和渔获评估，旨在估算渔获量、捕捞努力量、渔业收入及物种组成。调查记录到31个卸鱼点、683名渔民和173艘独木舟，日平均渔获2367尾、重1040.1 kg，以慈鲷科鱼类为主，共记录38种。渔业结构以手工捕捞为主，无机动船，缺乏鱼品处理设施。研究建议进一步开展boat activity survey和landings survey，以支持该湿地渔业的可持续管理。

papers.title: Silence in climate policy: fisheries, policy incentives, and the missing low-carbon transition in Brazil
papers.authors: Reis-Filho, José Amorim
papers.abstract: Greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation has become a central priority as countries align production systems with climate targets. Because emission reductions depend on regulatory frameworks that translate international commitments into operational measures, legal and policy architecture is decisive for low-carbon transitions. Fisheries, as a fuel-dependent food-producing and income-generating sector, are part of this governance chain, yet remain an overlooked arena for climate policy. This is particularly relevant in Brazil, a country with a prominent role in climate diplomacy but where fisheries are largely absent from the national mitigation agenda. This study examines how Brazil’s climate-related legal and regulatory architecture addresses extractive fisheries, focusing on mitigation, adaptation, and carbon governance. The results reveal a structural deficiency: Of the 110 federal legal instruments screened, 50% showed no relevant interface with climate governance, and only 14 were classified as having direct or indirect relevance to the fishing fleet. Yet none addressed core mitigation dimensions required for a sector-specific low-carbon transition, including emission inventories, decarbonization targets, or carbon-footprint management. At the same time, public policies have sustained substantial fossil-fuel subsidies, totaling approximately 5.25 billion liters of diesel between 1997 and 2025. Combined with a fleet age structure dominated by vessels built during the 2000s capitalization cycle, this trajectory reinforces carbon lock-in, as investment and engine decisions have long-term implications. The study proposes pathways to incorporate fisheries into Brazil’s mitigation framework, offering lessons for emerging economies facing similar governance gaps.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究审查巴西气候相关法律法规对捕捞渔业的覆盖情况，发现110项联邦法律文书中50%与气候治理无实质关联，仅14项与渔船队直接或间接相关，且无一涉及排放清单、脱碳目标或碳足迹管理等核心mitigation维度。与此同时，1997—2025年间化石燃料补贴累计约52.5亿升柴油，叠加2000年代资本化周期形成的船队老化结构，共同强化了carbon lock-in。研究提出将渔业纳入巴西mitigation框架的路径，为面临类似治理缺口的新兴经济体提供借鉴。

papers.title: Effects of consuming school meals enriched with fish powder on zinc status of school children in Malawi: study protocol for nourishing for knowledge: a randomized controlled trial
papers.authors: Ahern, Molly; Kjellevold, Marian; Markhus, Maria Wik; Kolding, Camilla; Kalimbira, Alexander
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Zinc is an essential trace element that has a role in preventing mortality and morbidity, as well as in linear growth, brain development and neuron activity. According to Malawi’s 2015/16 micronutrient survey, 60 percent of school-aged children and younger adolescents were zinc deficient. Fish and other aquatic foods are rich in essential micronutrients like zinc, vitamins A and B12, iron, iodine and the long-chain omega-3 fatty acids eicosapentaenoic acid and docosahexaenoic acid, all crucial for development, especially during early childhood and adolescence. However, these nutrients are often lacking from diets in Sub-Saharan Africa, contributing to persistent micronutrient deficiencies. The objective of this randomized controlled trial is to assess the impact of adding dried fish ( Engraulicypris sardella ) to cereal-based school meals on zinc status of children, measured through biomarker analysis, in selected pilot schools. Methods Two-armed randomized controlled trial where 272 adolescents in primary schools in Malawi of at least 10 years of age will be randomized to either receive the school meal as usual or school meal with 4 g of fish powder added, five days per week for one school term, lasting 14 weeks. Socioeconomic and demographic factors, dietary information and biological samples (dried blood spots) will be collected pre- and post-intervention and analyzed for zinc concentration as the primary outcome and other nutritional biomarkers as secondary outcomes. Discussion This study will provide knowledge on potential changes in zinc status when consuming locally-sourced fish powder made from dried small freshwater fish indigenous to Lake Malawi during adolescence. The results of the study will contribute to the understanding of the impact of a small quantity of fish consumed in school meals on the nutritional status of school-going children. Trial registration This study was registered in ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT07085871) on 17 July 2025. The full trial protocol and statistical analysis plan can be accessed through ClinicalTrials.gov.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在评估在马拉维学校膳食中添加由本地小型淡水鱼（Engraulicypris sardella）制成的鱼粉对学龄儿童 zinc 营养状况的影响。采用双臂随机对照试验设计，将272名10岁以上小学生随机分为常规校餐组和每日添加4g鱼粉的校餐组，干预持续14周，以干血斑 zinc 浓度为主要结局指标。该研究将为发展中国家利用本地水产资源改善儿童微量营养素缺乏提供证据。

papers.title: Quantitative Occurrence of Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons  in Heat-Processed Fish and Meat Products in Variable Processing  Matrices
papers.authors: Abdulrahman, Jimah
papers.journal: RESEARCH JOURNAL OF FOOD SCIENCE AND QUALITY CONTROL
papers.abstract: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) are carcinogenic contaminants formed endogenously during high-temperature processing of protein-rich foods. This investigation evaluated the occurrence and dietary risk associated with four priority PAHs — benzo[a]pyrene (BaP), chrysene (Chr), benz[a]anthracene (BaA) and benzo[b]fluoranthene (BbF), collectively termed PAH4 — in traditionally processed fish and meat foods sampled from markets across six geopolitical zones of Nigeria. A total of 60 samples comprising smoked catfish, smoked tilapia, smoked mackerel, suya, kilishi and balangu were collected and analysed by high-performance liquid chromatography with fluorescence detection (HPLC-FLD) following solid-phase extraction (SPE) clean-up. BaP concentrations ranged from 0.4 to 33.9 µg/kg across matrices, with smoked mackerel from Rivers State recording the highest mean value (12.1 ± 3.4 µg/kg). Traditional Nigerian grilled meat products exhibited markedly lower but still concerning PAH4 concentrations. Kilishi recorded higher BaP levels (5.1 µg/kg) than suya (6.2 µg/kg) while balangu showed lowest BaP value (4.7±1.5µg/kg). The EU regulatory maximum of 2 µg/kg was exceeded in 74.2% of smoked fish samples and 41.8% of grilled meat samples. In total PAH4, Rivers State recorded the highest mean PAH4 concentrations (44.2 µg/kg), Cross River State also demonstrated elevated contamination levels (41.7 µg/kg). In contrast, the FCT Abuja recorded comparatively lower levels (22.1 µg/kg). PAH4 sum exceeded 12 µg/kg in 68.4% of smoked fish products. In the case of fuel type, Rubber wood and sawdust frequently used by artisanal processors because of their low cost and wide availability generated PAH4 concentrations 2.3–2.9 fold higher than hardwood iroko and 2.9–3.7 fold higher than coconut shell charcoal. Significant correlations were found between PAH4 burden and fuel type (H = 41.3, p < 0.001), fat content (r = 0.98, p < 0.001) and processing temperature (r = 0.94, p < 0.001). These data underline an urgent need for harmonised Nigerian food safety regulations governing PAH limits in thermally processed protein foods, improved traditional smoking technologies, and targeted consumer risk education.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用HPLC-FLD结合SPE净化，检测了尼日利亚六大 geopolitical zone 市场采集的60份传统加工鱼肉类产品（熏鲶鱼、熏罗非鱼、熏鲭鱼、suya、kilishi、balangu）中四种优先多环芳烃（PAH4：BaP、Chr、BaA、BbF）的含量及膳食风险。结果显示，熏鱼中BaP超标（>2 µg/kg，EU限值）率达74.2%，熏鲭鱼均值最高（12.1 ± 3.4 µg/kg），Rivers State的PAH4总浓度最高（44.2 µg/kg）。PAH4负荷与燃料类型（橡胶木和锯末显著高于硬木和椰壳炭）、脂肪含量（r = 0.98）及加工温度（r = 0.94）显著相关，提示亟需制定尼日利亚热加工蛋白食品的PAH限量法规并改进传统熏制工艺。

papers.title: Intelligent Defect Recognition System for Fish Product Packaging Using Machine Vision
papers.authors: Sheremetev, A.N.; Luttseva, E.A.
papers.abstract: This paper presents a study on the development of an automatic quality control system for fish product packaging based on computer vision and convolutional neural networks. The relevance of the work is driven by the need to reduce human factor influence during visual inspection on conveyor lines, especially under high production rates and given the perishable nature of the product. To address this problem, the YOLO26 model was selected. A two-stage architecture is proposed: at the first stage, the YOLO26n model detects the box region in the frame (the frame is then cropped); at the second stage, a binary classifier built upon YOLO26s determines whether a packaging defect is present. This approach reduces classification errors caused by background differences between the dataset and real-world conditions. A custom labelled image dataset was collected on a prototype conveyor line. An experimental comparison of the YOLO26s, YOLOv8s, and YOLO11s classifiers was performed on the test set. Testing on a set of 108 images demonstrated an accuracy of 96.3% with false positive and false negative rates of 3.7% each. It is concluded that the developed system is applicable to the existing conveyor line prototype and can potentially be scaled to industrial fish processing plants. В статье представлено исследование по разработке системы автоматического контроля качества упаковки рыбной продукции на основе методов компьютерного зрения и свёрточных нейронных сетей. Актуальность работы обусловлена необходимостью снижения влияния человеческого фактора при визуальной инспекции на конвейерных линиях, особенно в условиях высокого темпа производства и скоропортящегося характера продукта. Для решения данной задачи была выбрана модель YOLO26. Предложена двухэтапная архитектура: на первом этапе модель YOLO26n детектирует область коробки на кадре (кадр обрезается), на втором этапе бинарный классификатор YOLO26s определяет наличие дефекта упаковки. Данный подход позволяет снизить ошибки модели классификации, связанные с некорректным обучением из-за различий фона между датасетом и реальными условиями. Собран собственный размеченный датасет изображений, полученный на прототипе конвейерной линии. Проведено экспериментальное сравнение классификаторов YOLO26s, YOLOv8s и YOLO11s на тестовой выборке. Тестирование на выборке из 108 изображений продемонстрировало точность 96,3% при доле ложноположительных и ложноотрицательных результатов по 3,7%. Сделан вывод о принципиальной применимости разработанной системы на существующем прототипе конвейерной линии и о возможности её масштабирования на промышленные рыбоперерабатывающие предприятия.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究开发了一套基于机器视觉与卷积神经网络的鱼类产品包装自动质检系统，旨在降低传送带视觉检验中人为因素的影响。系统采用两阶段架构：先由 YOLO26n 检测并裁剪包装箱区域，再由基于 YOLO26s 的二分类器判定包装是否存在缺陷，以缓解数据集与真实场景背景差异导致的分类误差。在自建传送带原型线图像数据集上测试，108 张图像的准确率达 96.3%，假阳性与假阴性率均为 3.7%，表明该系统可应用于现有原型线并具备向工业化鱼类加工厂推广的潜力。

papers.title: YOLO-CBNet: A robust attention-enhanced detection framework for underwater fish recognition in aquaculture environments
papers.authors: Hamzaoui, Mahdi; Bousbia, Leila; Ould-Elhassen Aoueileyine, Mohamed; Filali, Imen; Bouallegue, Ridha
papers.abstract: The accurate identification of fish species remains a pivotal challenge in aquaculture, as it directly influences population management, health monitoring, and overall production efficiency. Yet, underwater environments often present difficult conditions such as reduced visibility, suspended particles, and uneven lighting that significantly limit the performance of traditional recognition approaches. In this study, we introduce YOLO-CBNet, an enhanced architecture designed to overcome these constraints and provide more dependable monitoring in real-world aquaculture systems. The method adopts a two-stage strategy. First, a Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) module is employed to counter low contrast, turbidity, and color distortion, restoring essential visual information. Second, the YOLOv11 framework is refined through the integration of the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) and a Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN), a combination intended to improve multiscale feature fusion and reinforce the detection of small or partially occluded fish. Experimental results indicate that YOLO-CBNet delivers a clear performance boost, the precision score reaches 0.951, surpassing the baseline YOLOv11 model, which achieved 0.911 under the same conditions. These improvements highlight YOLO-CBNet’s potential as a reliable solution for underwater detection and recognition tasks within modern aquaculture environments.
papers.summary_cn: 针对水产养殖环境中水下图像低对比度、悬浮颗粒和光照不均导致的鱼类识别困难，本研究提出YOLO-CBNet检测框架，采用CLAHE增强图像对比度，并在YOLOv11中引入CBAM注意力模块和BiFPN多尺度特征融合网络。实验结果表明，该模型precision达0.951，优于基线YOLOv11的0.911，提升了对小型或部分遮挡鱼类的检测能力。

papers.title: Assessing the Stress Responses and Aquaculture Potential of Silver Barb (Barbonymus gonionotus) Under Saline Exposure
papers.authors: Saha, Srebash Kumar; Mahmud, Sujan; Mithun, Mahmudul Hasan; Ali, Azhar; Mou, Maliha Hossain; Amin, A.K.M Rohul
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the salinity adaptation capability of silver barb (Barbonymus gonionotus) by examining its physiological and behavioral stress responses under varying saline conditions. In an acute toxicity bioassay using the direct transfer method, 180 fish were exposed to salinity levels ranging from 0 to 16 ppt for 72 hours. The species survived exposure up to 12 ppt, with a 72-hour median lethal salinity LC50 of 14 ppt determined via probit analysis. Subsequent 72-hour evaluations of body weight dynamics, gill histology, and behavior were conducted across two sub-lethal salinities (8 ppt and 12 ppt) and two lethal salinities (14 ppt and 16 ppt). Fish exposed to sub-lethal concentrations (up to 12 ppt) displayed minimal behavioral distress, a gradual decline in body weight, and minor gill alterations restricted to lamellar rupture accompanied by light mucus secretion. Conversely, exposure to lethal salinities (14 ppt and 16 ppt) induced severe physiological and behavioral stress including rapid osmotic body weight loss, marked hyper-agitation, erratic swimming, and accelerated opercular movements. Histological analysis of gills from lethally exposed fish revealed extensive structural damage, including curved and broken filaments, severe lamellar rupture, and tissue necrosis. These findings demonstrate that while elevated salinity significantly disrupts the physiology and behavior of silver barb near lethal thresholds, the species possesses sufficient tolerance to make it a promising candidate for aquaculture in low-salinity brackish environments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过急性毒性实验和亚致死/致死盐度暴露，评估了银鲃（Barbonymus gonionotus）的盐度适应能力及其养殖潜力。72小时急性毒性实验表明该鱼种可存活至12 ppt，LC50为14 ppt；亚致死盐度（≤12 ppt）下行为应激轻微、体重渐降、鳃部仅见轻微鳃片破裂，而致死盐度（14–16 ppt）则引发严重渗透性失重、剧烈躁动及鳃组织广泛坏死。结果表明银鲃对低盐度耐受性良好，适合作为低盐度咸淡水养殖的候选鱼种。

papers.title: From "White Pollution" to "Blue Granary": a multidimensional value study of the transition from traditional to ecological aquaculture
papers.authors: Xie, Jie'an; Zeng, Tianlang; Du, Yuchen; Bai, Haotian
papers.journal: Journal of Applied Economics and Policy Studies
papers.abstract: Background: Traditional foam-based aquaculture in Dongshan Bay, Fujian, caused severe white pollution and ocean eutrophication. This study examines the multidimensional value of the transition from traditional to ecological aquaculture in the Xiaxikeng area. Methods: Field interviews with fishermen, on-site inspections, statistical analysis, and literature review were conducted. Results: Replacement of ~400,000 EPS foam buoys with HDPE plastic buoys, removal of 41,407 mu of illegal aquaculture, and installation of 100,000 plastic cages achieved significant ecological restoration. The 10,600-mu shellfish-algae co-culture area yields an annual carbon sink of 16,772.41 t, CO2-equivalent (~¥946,100). Village collective income rose from ¥360,000 (2018) to ¥2.22 million (2024). Conclusions: The transition creates a positive feedback loop among ecological restoration, economic growth, and social governance, providing a replicable model for coastal China.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以福建东山湾下西坑海域为案例，探讨传统泡沫养殖向生态养殖转型的多维价值。通过渔民访谈、实地调查与统计分析，发现以HDPE浮球替代约40万个EPS泡沫浮球、清退41,407亩非法养殖并布设10万个塑料网箱后，生态修复成效显著；10,600亩贝藻混养区年碳汇达16,772.41 t CO2当量（约¥946,100），村集体收入由2018年的36万元增至2024年的222万元。研究表明，该转型形成了生态修复、经济增长与社会治理的良性循环，为中国沿海地区提供了可推广模式。

papers.title: Occurrence, distribution, and tissue concentrations of organochlorine pesticides in marine sediments, bivalves, and two reef fish (Siganus sutor and Lethrinus nebulosus) from coastal waters of Unguja Island, Tanzania: baseline levels, sediment-quality screening and dietary risk
papers.authors: Hassan, Hassan; Mmochi, Aviti John; Haji, Haji Mwevura
papers.abstract: Organochlorine pesticides (OCPs) persist in tropical marine ecosystems, yet baseline data for the eastern and northern coasts of Unguja Island, Tanzania, are absent. This study quantified ten target OCPs (α-HCH, aldrin, dieldrin, endosulfan, p,p′-DDE, p,p′-DDT, isodrin, endrin, endrin ketone and heptachlor epoxide) in surface sediments, bivalves, rabbit fish (Siganus sutor) and spangled emperor (Lethrinus nebulosus) at Chwaka (east coast) and Nungwi (northern tip) by gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (three station composites per matrix per site; n = 3). Nine compounds were detected; endosulfan was not detected in any sample, and α-HCH, endrin and heptachlor epoxide were below detection in all sediments. Mean ΣOCP in sediment was 59.4 ± 23.4 ng g−1 dry weight (dw) at Chwaka and 57.5 ± 23.4 at Nungwi, dominated by endrin ketone, p,p′-DDT and p,p′-DDE. Inter-site differences were negligible to small (Hedges’ g = 0.06–0.48); at n = 3 the design resolves only differences of 72–310 ng g−1 at 80% power, so non-significant results are inconclusive rather than evidence of spatial homogeneity. Mean ΣOCP was higher in biota than in co-located sediment (bivalves 97.9; rabbit fish 121.6; spangled emperor 182.6 ng g−1 dw; matrix-to-sediment concentration quotients 1.7–3.1). Because sediment organic carbon, tissue lipid content and trophic position were not measured, these quotients are descriptive only and are explicitly not interpreted as bioaccumulation, biota–sediment accumulation factors, or trophic transfer. Sediment p,p′-DDT (9.7–29.1) and dieldrin (10.1–22.1 ng g−1 dw) exceeded CCME marine interim sediment quality guidelines and probable-effect levels, indicating a screening-level probability of adverse effects on benthic biota. Sediment DDE/(DDE+DDT) ratios of 0.29–0.40 indicate a DDT-dominated signal consistent with comparatively recent input, whereas the endrin-ketone-dominated cyclodiene profile indicates legacy input. No matrix approached US FDA action levels for fish. Deterministic dietary estimates nevertheless gave hazard indices above 1 for high and child consumers at several matrix–site combinations, and incremental lifetime cancer risks of 1.1 × 10−5 to 6.2 × 10−4 exceeding the 10−4 benchmark for high consumers driven by dieldrin and aldrin. Wet-weight confirmation, lipid and organic-carbon data, and local consumption rates are the priority next steps.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究首次报道了坦桑尼亚Unguja岛东岸Chwaka和北端Nungwi沿海表层沉积物、双壳类及两种礁鱼（*Siganus sutor*、*Lethrinus nebulosus*）中10种有机氯农药（OCPs）的基线水平，采用GC-MS测定，沉积物ΣOCP均值约58–59 ng g⁻¹ dw，以endrin ketone、p,p′-DDT和p,p′-DDE为主，生物体ΣOCP高于沉积物（双壳类97.9、兔鱼121.6、星斑裸颊鲷182.6 ng g⁻¹ dw）。沉积物中p,p′-DDT和dieldrin超过CCME海洋临时沉积物质量指南及可能效应水平，DDE/(DDE+DDT)比值（0.29–0.40）指示DDT近期输入与cyclodiene类历史残留并存。确定性膳食评估显示高消费人群和儿童在多个组合中危害指数>1，高消费人群的增量终生致癌风险（1.1×10⁻⁵–6.2×10⁻⁴）超过10⁻⁴基准，主要驱动污染物为dieldrin和aldrin。

papers.title: A Game-Aware Dual-Mode Switching Cooperative Hunting Control Method for Multiple Biomimetic Robotic Fish
papers.authors: Wang, Xinqi; Wang, Ming; Ma, Hanbin; Liu, Xinyang; Pan, Sida; Yu, Junzhi
papers.summary_cn: 提出一种面向多仿生机器鱼协同围捕的博弈感知双模式切换控制方法，旨在提升围捕任务中的协作效率与适应性。

papers.title: A multi-model framework for evaluating and partitioning environmental change impacts on fish population dynamics: a case study with Lake Erie Yellow Perch
papers.authors: Xu, Luoliang; Brooks, George C; Bi, Rujia; Ludsin, Stuart A.; Jiao, Yan; Jensen, Olaf P.
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Environmental change influences fish populations through multiple demographic pathways, yet most studies either assess overall productivity without identifying mechanisms or examine individual processes in isolation. Here, we develop a multi-model framework linking environmental changes in population productivity to specific demographic processes. The framework integrates models describing environment-dependent recruitment, somatic growth, natural mortality, and surplus production. We apply this approach to yellow perch (Perca flavescens) in Lake Erie, where recent decades have seen substantial environmental changes, including shorter winter ice cover and reduced nutrient loading. Both ice-on duration and nutrient loading were positively associated with population productivity. Ice-on duration primarily enhanced productivity via increased recruitment and adult growth, while partially offsetting increases in natural mortality. In contrast, nutrient loading showed consistent positive effects on demographic processes, including higher recruitment, lower natural mortality, and increased adult growth. In turn, the combined effects of long-term reductions in ice-on duration and nutrient loading reduced yellow perch maximum sustainable yield by 40% during 1975-2020. Our proposed framework provides a structured approach for identifying the mechanisms linking environmental variability to fish population productivity.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究构建了一个多模型框架，将环境变化对鱼类种群生产力的影响分解至具体的种群统计过程（补充、体生长、自然死亡和剩余产量），并以伊利湖黄鲈（Perca flavescens）为案例进行验证。结果表明，结冰期时长和营养盐负荷均与种群生产力正相关：结冰期主要通过提高补充量和成鱼生长来增强生产力，同时部分抵消自然死亡率的上升；营养盐负荷则对补充量、自然死亡率和成鱼生长均产生一致的正面效应。1975—2020年间，结冰期缩短与营养盐负荷降低的联合效应使黄鲈 maximum sustainable yield 下降40%。
