papers.title: Dietary naringenin modulates antioxidant status and hepatic lipid deposition in marine medaka (Oryzias dancena) fed a high-fat diet
papers.authors: Tari, Tejas Santosh; Selvam, Chandrasekar; A., Mariselvammurugan; Hareendran, Smruthi; Thara, Nayan; D., Linga Prabu; Ebeneezar, Sanal; Gora, Adnan H.; Gop, Ambarish P.; Pradhan, Chiranjiv
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以海水青鳉（Oryzias dancena）为模型，探讨高脂饲料中添加柚皮素（naringenin）对抗氧化状态及肝脏脂质沉积的调控作用。摘要缺失，具体方法、剂量效应及分子机制尚不明确。

papers.title: Malic enzyme locus influences Atlantic salmon maturation probability in controlled conditions
papers.authors: Frapin, Morgane; Lamarins, Amaïa; Lindeza, Ana Sofia; Piavchenko, Nikolai; Prokkola, Jenni M.; Maamela, Katja Susanna; Primmer, Craig R
papers.abstract: Atlantic salmon life-histories are shaped by interactions between environmental and genetic factors. The mitochondrial NADP-dependent malic enzyme (me3 or mMEP-2), historically described as a polymorphic allozyme varying across populations, has been associated with age at maturity in wild populations. However, more recently, other loci (vgll3 and six6) have also been shown to influence age at maturity, and studies disentangling their relative effects are lacking. This is especially important given that me3 and vgll3 are located on the same chromosome. Here, we used a common-garden experiment to investigate the impact of the me3 locus on male parr maturation probability in a Finnish population whilst accounting for variation at the vgll3 and six6 loci. Although we found linkage disequilibrium between the me3 and vgll3 loci, me3 remained moderately associated with maturation probability even when vgll3 genotype was accounted for. Together, these results support observations from wild populations of a genetic effect of me3 on maturation probability, but they also highlight the importance of considering both me3 and vgll3 when investigating the mechanism linking these loci to maturation.
papers.summary_cn: 大西洋鲑生活史受环境和遗传因子共同影响。本研究通过 common-garden 实验，在控制 vgll3 和 six6 位点变异的条件下，探究 me3 位点对芬兰种群雄性 parr 成熟概率的影响。结果显示 me3 与 vgll3 存在 linkage disequilibrium，但在校正 vgll3 基因型后 me3 仍与成熟概率呈中等程度关联，表明 me3 对大西洋鲑成熟概率具有遗传效应，且研究该机制时需同时考虑 me3 和 vgll3 两个位点。

papers.title: A new species of the genus Neolamprologus (Cichliformes: Cichlidae) from Lake Tanganyika
papers.authors: Takahashi, Tetsumi; Snoeks, Jos; Satoh, Shun
papers.abstract: Abstract Lake Tanganyika harbours an exceptionally diverse fauna of cichlids that has arisen through explosive adaptive radiation. During a recent survey at Kasenga and Kombe, Zambia, we discovered an undescribed species of the genus Neolamprologus . The new species is readily distinguished from its congeners by its uniquely developed upper lip, which protrudes conspicuously beyond the lower lip, along with several additional morphological characters. Phylogenetic analysis of the mitochondrial NADH dehydrogenase subunit 2 gene showed that specimens of the new species were not recovered as monophyletic; instead, they formed a clade together with Neolamprologus mustax . Nevertheless, the new species is morphologically clearly distinct from N. mustax despite their sympatric occurrence. This discovery highlights the still underestimated diversity of cichlids in Lake Tanganyika and underscores the importance of documenting its fauna in the face of increasing anthropogenic pressures on the lake's ecosystem.
papers.summary_cn: 坦噶尼喀湖慈鲷多样性极高，源于爆发性适应性辐射。在赞比亚Kasenga和Kombe的调查中发现并描述了一新种Neolamprologus，以上唇显著突出于下唇等形态特征区别于同属其他种。线粒体ND2基因系统发育分析显示该新种与N. mustax聚为一支，但两者同域分布且形态明显不同。该发现表明坦噶尼喀湖慈鲷多样性仍被低估，凸显在人为压力加剧背景下开展区系记录的重要性。

papers.title: The new norm: Climate change, marine heatwaves and the impact on aquatic systems
papers.authors: Perry, William Bernard
papers.summary_cn: 综述气候变化背景下海洋热浪对水生生态系统的生态影响，涉及物种分布、生理适应及群落结构变化等议题。

papers.title: Rosmarinus officinalis essential oil components promote anaesthesia in Colossoma macropomum (Cuvier, 1818) through behavioural and cardiorespiratory modulation
papers.authors: de Almeida, Lorena Cristina Nunes; Lins, Axell; de Araújo, Daniella Bastos; Hamoy, Maria Klara Otake; dos Santos Brito, Marcelo Victor; de Souza, Luana Vasconcelos; Câmara, Sarah Farias; Quirino, Luciana Eiro; Muto, Nilton Akio; Hamoy, Moisés
papers.abstract: Abstract Anaesthetic management plays a crucial role in maintaining the welfare and physiological stability of fish during routine aquaculture and research procedures. The essential oil of Rosmarinus officinalis (ROEO) has emerged as a promising natural anaesthetic; however, its cardiophysiological effects in Amazonian species remain underexplored. This study assessed the behavioural, electrocardiographic and respiratory responses of Colossoma macropomum (tambaqui) exposed to ROEO, aiming to define safe and effective concentrations as a natural anaesthetic agent in a Neotropical teleost species. Juvenile tambaqui were exposed to immersion baths containing 90.60–181.20 mg L −1 ROEO for 5 min. Behavioural endpoints (latency to loss and recovery of postural reflex), electrocardiographic parameters (heart rate, QRS amplitude, R–R, P–Q and Q–T intervals) and opercular frequency were monitored. The oil composition was determined by gas chromatography. Statistical analyses were performed using one‐way ANOVA, followed by Tukey's test ( p < 0.05). ROEO produced a clear dose‐dependent anaesthetic response, characterized by faster induction and prolonged recovery times at higher concentrations. Cardiac monitoring revealed reversible bradycardia (up to −56%), elongation of R–R and Q–T intervals and a slight reduction in QRS amplitude without arrhythmias. Opercular frequency decreased by up to 38% at 181.20 mg L −1 , indicating moderate respiratory depression. All effects were reversible within the recovery period. Eucalyptol (47.5%), camphor (19.3%) and α‐pinene (12.2%) were the main phytoconstituents identified. Rosmarinus officinalis essential oil provides a safe, reversible and concentration‐dependent anaesthetic effect in C. macropomum , maintaining sinus rhythm and physiological recovery. These results highlight ROEO as a biodegradable, low‐toxicity and effective alternative to synthetic anaesthetics, reinforcing its applicability for sustainable and welfare‐oriented aquaculture practices.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了迷迭香（Rosmarinus officinalis）精油（ROEO）对亚马逊物种 tambaqui（Colossoma macropomum）幼鱼的麻醉效果，通过浸浴暴露（90.60–181.20 mg L⁻¹，5 min）监测行为、心电图及呼吸反应。ROEO产生剂量依赖性麻醉效应，高浓度下诱导更快、恢复更久，伴随可逆性心动过缓（心率最大下降56%）、R–R和Q–T间期延长及QRS波幅轻微降低，但无心律失常；鳃盖频率最大下降38%，提示中度呼吸抑制。主要成分为eucalyptol（47.5%）、camphor（19.3%）和α-pinene（12.2%），所有效应在恢复期内均可逆，表明ROEO是一种安全、可逆、可生物降解的低毒天然麻醉剂替代品。

papers.title: An artificially developed peptide with anti-oomycete activity against Saprolegnia
papers.authors: Tandel, Ritesh Shantilal; Khangembam, Victoria Chanu; Dash, Pragyan; Bhat, Raja Aadil Hussain; Thakuria, Dimpal
papers.summary_cn: 该研究涉及人工合成肽对卵菌 Saprolegnia 的拮抗活性，Saprolegnia 是鱼类水霉病的主要病原，与水产养殖健康管理相关，但标题未提供摘要，具体方法、抗性机制及渔业应用效果均不明确。

papers.title: Opsarius geminus, a new danionid fish from the Western Ghats, India and revalidation of Barilius papillatus Day 1869 (Teleostei: Danionidae)
papers.authors: VIJAYAKRISHNAN, BALAJI; NALLATHAMBI, MOULITHARAN; JAYASIMHAN, PRAVEENRAJ; KNIGHT, J.D. MARCUS
papers.abstract: Opsarius geminus, a new species of danionid fish is described from the Krishna River, Western Ghats, India. It can be distinguished from its congeners in the Western Ghats by possessing a combination of the following characters: unique colour pattern consisting of 9–11 blue bars that are 2–3 scales wide; 46–51 lateral-line scales; 20–23 pre-dorsal scales; barbels absent; length of last dorsal-fin ray almost equal to, or greater than length of first dorsal-fin ray; 7 ½–8½ dorsal-fin branched rays and 10½–11½ anal-fin branched rays. Barilius papillatus Day 1869, currently a synonym of Opsarius barna (Hamilton, 1822) is redescribed, based on the syntype and fresh specimens, and a lectotype is designated to fix its identity. Opsarius papillatus can be diagnosed from all its congeners in India, by possessing a combination of the following characters: colour pattern consisting of 7–9 blue bars that are 1–2 scales wide; 39–41 lateral-line scales; 15–18 pre-dorsal scales; barbels absent; length of last dorsal-fin ray shorter than length of first dorsal-fin ray; 7½ dorsal-fin branched rays and 10½ anal-fin branched rays.
papers.summary_cn: 描述了印度西高止山脉Krishna河发现的丹尼奥科鱼类新种Opsarius geminus，其鉴别特征包括9–11条蓝色横纹、46–51枚侧线鳞、无触须及背鳍末根鳍条长度等组合性状。同时对原为Opsarius barna同物异名的Barilius papillatus Day 1869进行了重新描述并指定选模，确认其有效种地位为Opsarius papillatus，该种可通过7–9条蓝色横纹、39–41枚侧线鳞等特征与印度同属其他种区分。

papers.title: Otolith Morphological Characteristics of Major Schizothoracinae Fish Species in Tibet and Genus-Level Morphological Discrimination
papers.authors: Wang, Yunfei; Zhou, Yang; Qiao, Liuxuan; Zhang, Haoran; Long, Lijing; Su, Jian; Zhou, Chaowei; Han, Zhaofang; Liu, Haiping
papers.abstract: Schizothoracinae represent an endemic and dominant teleost group in the Qinghai–Xizang Plateau and adjacent regions. Despite their rich species diversity, closely related Schizothoracinae species exhibit remarkable external morphological similarity, which hinders traditional morphological discrimination. In this study, lapillus otoliths from 360 individuals representing 12 Schizothoracinae species collected across major Tibetan water systems were systematically examined. We evaluated and compared the performance of traditional scalar-based shape indices and Elliptic Fourier Analysis (EFA, 60 normalized harmonic coefficients following size-allometry correction) in otolith contour quantification and species identification. Statistical analyses including one-way ANOVA, principal component analysis (PCA), non-linear manifold learning (t-SNE and UMAP), and linear discriminant analysis (LDA) were executed. One-way ANOVA revealed highly significant differences among all 12 species across all shape indices and Fourier coefficients. The overall LDA classification accuracy was 35.3% for the shape index method, whereas EFA achieved a higher overall accuracy of 68.3%, representing a 33.0 percentage point improvement. Under EFA, Schizothorax lhasaensis (93.3%) and Schizothorax nukiangensis (90.0%) demonstrated the highest single-species discrimination success. Interspecific otolith morphological divergence was substantially higher in the riverine genus Schizothorax than in lacustrine genera (Gymnocypris and Schizopygopsis), the latter two of which show extensive morphological overlap consistent with their low genomic differentiation. Fishes of Gymnocypris displayed significantly higher otolith roundness (p < 0.05), which correlates with their adaptation to lacustrine or sluggish water habitats. Our findings demonstrate that EFA effectively captures multi-scale otolith contour harmonics, serving as a valuable morphometric approach for Schizothoracinae species identification and morphological discrimination, although challenges remain for species with incomplete lineage sorting. The morphometric database established herein provides valuable morphological baselines for the conservation and management of endemic QXP fish resources.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究系统采集了西藏主要水系12种裂腹鱼类（Schizothoracinae）共360尾个体的星耳石（lapillus），比较了传统形状指数与椭圆傅里叶分析（EFA）在耳石轮廓量化及物种判别中的表现。单因素方差分析显示12个物种在所有形状指标和傅里叶系数上均存在极显著差异，EFA整体判别准确率达68.3%，较形状指数法（35.3%）提高33.0个百分点，其中拉萨裂腹鱼（93.3%）和怒江裂腹鱼（90.0%）判别成功率最高。河流型裂腹鱼属（Schizothorax）的种间耳石形态分化显著高于湖泊型裸鲤属（Gymnocypris）和重唇鱼属（Schizopygopsis），后两者形态高度重叠，与其低基因组分化一致；裸鲤属耳石圆度显著偏高，与其湖泊或缓流水栖息适应相关。研究表明EFA能有效捕捉多尺度耳石轮廓谐波特征，可作为裂腹鱼类物种鉴定的有效形态计量手段，所建形态数据库为青藏高原特有鱼类资源保护与管理提供了基础资料。

papers.title: Diversity, antifungal susceptibility, and biofilm formation of fish-associated yeasts from freshwater and marine fish
papers.authors: Karadal, Fulden; Cufaoglu, Gizem; Ipek, Pınar; Sakin Sahin, Tuba; Ozkaya, Yasin; Ertas Onmaz, Nurhan
papers.summary_cn: 该研究针对淡水与海水鱼类相关酵母，拟探究其多样性、抗真菌药物敏感性及生物膜形成能力。摘要缺失，具体方法、菌种组成及耐药与成膜特征尚不明确。

papers.title: The first GBIF dataset on the distribution of fish assemblage in inland and transitional waters of Sicily (Central Mediterranean Basin)
papers.authors: Battiata, Matteo; Badalucco, Antonina; Pulieri, Martina; Bellissimo, Giancarlo; Li Vorsi, Andrea; Sirchia, Benedetto; Sarà, Gianluca; Lo Brutto, Sabrina
papers.journal: Biogeographia – The Journal of Integrative Biogeography
papers.abstract: Mediterranean inland and transitional waters are fragile ecosystems currently facing rapid biodiversity loss due to anthropogenic pressures and climate change. In Sicily, the largest island in the Mediterranean Sea, knowledge of ichthyofaunal assemblages of these ecosystems has remained fragmented, sporadic, and largely confined to "grey" literature for long. The present paper presents a dataset built with the aim to fill this gap. The dataset aggregates 808 occurrence records from 108 water bodies and localities, spanning a 50-year period (1976–2025). Data were recovered from diverse sources, including scientific literature, administrative reports, and conference proceedings, integrated with new unpublished data from recent field monitoring campaigns conducted by ARPA Sicilia following WFD (2000/60/EC) standards. Additionally, other unpublished data from direct information, interviews with local fishermen and acquisition of photographic records directly provided by citizens, were incorporated. The dataset is published on the GBIF platform. It is organized following to the Darwin Core (DwC) standards, in accordance with the FAIR (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reusability) Principles. All records were georeferenced using WGS84 coordinates, validated via QGIS, and taxonomically updated according to the World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS) and the Catalogue of Life. The dataset covers 90 species across 26 orders and 41 families, and 68 genera, while the investigated area documents a wide range of habitats, from natural rivers and coastal lagoons to artificial reservoirs and saltworks. The records reveal a research effort geographically asymmetric, with 75% of occurrences concentrated in the eastern portion of the island.
papers.summary_cn: 该数据集整合了西西里岛（地中海中部）内陆与过渡水域1976–2025年间108个水体的808条鱼类出现记录，数据来源于科学文献、行政报告、会议论文及ARPA Sicilia依据WFD标准的实地监测，并按Darwin Core标准发布于GBIF平台。数据集涵盖90种、26目、41科，生境类型包括自然河流、沿海潟湖、人工水库和盐田。记录显示研究努力在地理上分布不均，75%的出现记录集中于岛屿东部。

papers.title: Cross-Sectional Associations of Work Fatigue with Repetitive-Task Risk, Sleep Quality, and Body Mass Index among Informal Fish-Smoking Workers
papers.authors: Ekawati; Jayanti, Siswi; Suroto
papers.abstract: Introduction: Workers in informal industries are routinely exposed to physical, environmental, and ergonomic stressors that may be associated with fatigue and musculoskeletal strain. This study examined the cross-sectional associations of repetitive-task risk, sleep quality, body mass index, and selected individual characteristics with work fatigue among fish-smoking workers in Semarang, Indonesia. Methods: Using a cross-sectional design, data were collected from 64 workers through structured questionnaires, observational assessments, and anthropometric measurements. Fatigue levels were measured using the Indonesian version of the Japanese Industrial Fatigue Research Committee (JIFRC) Fatigue Questionnaire, repetitive-task risk was assessed using the Assessment of Repetitive Tasks (ART) method, and sleep quality was assessed using the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), which evaluates subjective sleep quality over the preceding month. Results: Moderate fatigue was reported by 59.4% of participants. In the bivariate analysis, left-hand repetitive-task risk was associated with fatigue (p = 0.037), whereas right-hand repetitive-task risk and the dichotomised sleep-quality category were not associated with fatigue. In the adjusted linear regression model, the left-hand association was attenuated (B = 0.028, p = 0.839), while BMI remained associated with the coded fatigue outcome (B = 0.181, 95% CI 0.047 to 0.316, p = 0.009). The overall regression model explained 21.3% of the variation in fatigue (R² = 0.213; adjusted R² = 0.115) and did not reach the conventional threshold for statistical significance (F (7, 56) = 2.166, p = 0.051). These estimates should be interpreted cautiously because of the small sample and imbalanced categories. Conclusion: Among workers in the participating fish-smoking centres, BMI was associated with the coded fatigue outcome after adjustment, while the unadjusted association involving left-hand repetitive-task risk was not retained in the adjusted model. Because the overall regression model was marginally non-significant, the individual adjusted associations should be interpreted cautiously. The findings identify anthropometric assessment, fatigue screening, and further task-specific ergonomic evaluation as priorities for future health-promotion research. Longitudinal and intervention studies are needed before conclusions can be drawn regarding causality, intervention effectiveness, or productivity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印尼三宝垄64名非正规鱼熏制工人为对象，采用横断面设计，通过JIFRC疲劳问卷、ART重复性任务风险评估、PSQI睡眠质量及人体测量，探讨重复性任务风险、睡眠质量与BMI与工作疲劳的关联。结果显示59.4%工人报告中度疲劳；双变量分析中左手重复性任务风险与疲劳相关（p=0.037），但调整后该关联消失，而BMI仍与疲劳编码结局独立相关（B=0.181，p=0.009）。整体回归模型仅解释21.3%变异且未达统计学显著（p=0.051），作者建议谨慎解读，并呼吁开展纵向与干预研究以明确因果关系。

papers.title: The nutritional and aquafeed potential of Marphysa iloiloensis Glasby et al., 2019: A review on the role of polychaetes as a protein source in aquaculture
papers.authors: Jabines, Rochelle A.; Ragaza, Janice A.
papers.abstract: Polychaetes are considered high-value feed resources in aquaculture because of their high protein content, well-balanced amino acid and fatty acid profiles, and diverse bioactive compounds. Their inclusion in diets has been consistently associated with enhanced reproductive output, larval quality, and feed efficiency in both crustacean and finfish culture. The recently described mud polychaete Marphysa iloiloensis Glasby et al., 2019 is endemic to the Philippines and is one such species that is showing potential as a sustainable protein source in aquaculture. This review synthesizes existing literature on the nutritional composition, biology, aquafeed applications, and rearing potential of M. iloiloensis and related Marphysa species. The available evidence suggests that M. iloiloensis may serve as a sustainable protein source that can be cultured using low-cost inputs within circular economy frameworks. However, the broader application of M. iloiloensis in hatcheries is constrained by several knowledge gaps. These include the need for complete fatty acid and amino acid profiling, digestibility and palatability assessments in target species, determination of optimal dietary inclusion levels, evaluation of the effects of processing and preservation methods on nutrient stability, and hatchery-scale cost-benefit analyses in local hatchery systems. This review consolidates current knowledge and identifies these gaps to support the development of M. iloiloensis as a reliable and sustainable aquafeed ingredient.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了多毛类（polychaetes）作为水产饲料蛋白源的营养特性，重点聚焦菲律宾特有种 Marphysa iloiloensis 的营养组成、生物学特性、饲料应用及养殖潜力。多毛类因高蛋白含量、均衡的氨基酸与脂肪酸谱及多种生物活性物质，被证实可提升甲壳类和鱼类养殖中的繁殖性能、幼体质量与饲料效率。M. iloiloensis 有望在循环经济框架下利用低成本投入进行养殖，成为可持续蛋白源，但其在孵化场中的广泛应用仍受限于脂肪酸与氨基酸全谱分析、消化率与适口性评估、最适饲料添加水平、加工保存对营养稳定性的影响及孵化场规模成本效益分析等知识空白。

papers.title: Carp Pathogens of Recreational and Ornamental Aquaculture: What Lies Beneath the Surface?
papers.authors: Makin, Eleanor; Satkunarasa, Harini; Gordon, Kyle; Reynolds, Paula; Wellby, Ian; Locker, Jessica; Qutachi, Omar; Young, Chris
papers.abstract: The farming and rearing of freshwater fishes is increasing in scale in response to growing global food demands, but notably also through the increasing popularity of sport angling and expansion of ornamental hobbyist practices globally. Alongside rises in numbers of fish and the intensity of their rearing, increases in aquatic and ecosystem stressors have expedited the emergence and motility of many pathogenic diseases. Cyprinids are the most popular species for culturing, and although largely considered hardy, are susceptible to a diverse array of pathogens. Common carp (Cyprinus carpio) and ornamental koi carp (Cyprinus rubrofuscus) are valued for their ease of cultivation, fast growth rates, and variety of genetic appearances. Vaccination programmes have become a mainstay of industrial aquaculture where financially viable, but their use in fish reared as companion animals or for sport angling is not cost-effective and despite the magnitude and growth of these markets, much less is known about current threats and trends in this area of aquaculture. Here, we review the bacterial, viral, and fungal infections commonly found within carp bred for angling and ornamental aquaculture in the United Kingdom and Europe, alongside current threats such as antimicrobial resistance and the potential impact of climate change on temperature-dependent infections. We highlight the evolution of diagnostic techniques, alternative therapies to reduce antibiotic dependence, and the environmental impact of available treatments as priority areas for cyprinid research. Additionally, there is an urgent need for novel therapeutics in this area, as innovation is currently lacking.
papers.summary_cn: 鲤科鱼类是垂钓与观赏水产养殖的主要品种，但其病害研究远落后于食用鱼工业化养殖。本文综述了英国和欧洲垂钓及观赏养殖鲤中常见的细菌、病毒和真菌感染，并探讨了antimicrobial resistance与气候变化对温度依赖性感染的潜在影响。作者指出诊断技术演进、减少抗生素依赖的替代疗法及治疗环境效应是鲤科研究的优先方向，同时亟需开发新型治疗手段。

papers.title: Density-Response-Oriented Low-Visibility and High-Density Underwater Fish Counting for Intelligent Recirculating Aquaculture Monitoring
papers.authors: Che, Xing; Yang, Renyou
papers.abstract: Non-contact underwater fish counting supports stocking-density estimation and management in intelligent aquaculture. This study evaluated a 900-image annotated TV5/IOC in-domain dataset derived from the right-view stream of one source video. For each of three seed-controlled splits, 720 images were used for training and 180 for validation. All controlled configurations used the same raw single-view (Raw-SV) supervised and inference input. High-density-aware density modeling (HDA-DM) applies a mild sample weight only to the density loss of high-count training images. HDA-DM reduced the Main900 three-seed mean MAE from 4.024 ± 0.578 to 3.739 ± 0.414 (7.07%) and reduced the Hard200 challenging-case mean MAE from 9.799 ± 1.792 to 8.863 ± 0.304 (9.56%). The improvement was not identical in every seed. Cross-view density distillation (CVDD), evaluated as a training-only ablation, did not further improve HDA-DM: the combined configuration obtained 3.987 ± 0.635 on Main900 and 9.666 ± 1.373 on Hard200. A loss-scope audit further showed that the original density-only HDA-DM formulation outperformed weighting density, count, and shape supervision together. HDA-DM introduces no additional inference-stage parameters or operations. Because the evidence is limited to three seeds and one acquisition source, all comparisons are descriptive and no formal statistical-significance or external-generalization claim is made.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对智能循环水养殖中的非接触式水下鱼群计数问题，基于单一视频源右视流构建的900张标注TV5/IOC域内数据集（720训练/180验证，三种子控制划分），评估了高密度感知密度建模（HDA-DM）与跨视角密度蒸馏（CVDD）两种策略。HDA-DM仅对高计数训练图像的密度损失施加温和样本权重，将Main900三种子平均MAE从4.024±0.578降至3.739±0.414（7.07%），Hard200困难样本平均MAE从9.799±1.792降至8.863±0.304（9.56%），且不增加推理阶段参数或运算；CVDD作为仅训练消融未带来进一步提升。损失范围审计表明，仅密度监督的原始HDA-DM优于密度、计数与形状联合加权。受限于三种子与单一采集源，所有比较均为描述性，未作统计显著性及外部泛化声明。

papers.title: An initial survey of inland fish communities and conservation within the Lana Oil Palm Estate, Kapit, Sarawak, Malaysia
papers.authors: Giman, Belden; Richard, Rendall; Gerusu, Geoffery James; Ismail, Johan; Hamli, Hadi
papers.abstract: Freshwater habitats globally represent some of the most threatened ecosystems due to intensifying land use conversion, deforestation, and agricultural expansion. In Southeast Asia, the widespread establishment of oil palm plantation monocultures poses significant challenges to stream biodiversity. Although natural environments in Sarawak, Malaysian Borneo, have undergone major modifications for oil palm cultivation, the precise ecological impacts on native fish species in remote districts such as Lana, Kapit, remain under documented. To bridge this knowledge gap regarding Sarawak’s agricultural streams, an inventory was conducted across four river sites within the Glenealy Lana Oil Palm Estate in Kapit. Sampling in April 2025, using standard 50 m x 2 m (2-inch mesh) gill nets deployed for three hours, yielded 19 freshwater fish species across four distinct families. Cyprinidae was the dominant group (55% of species), followed by Danionidae (30%), while Bagridae, Cobitidae, and Gastromyzonidae each comprised 5%. Barbonymus collingwoodii exhibited a ubiquitous distribution across all sampling stations, reflecting notable ecological plasticity. Conversely, species such as Rasbora argyrotaenia, Gastromyzon ctenocephalus, Rasbora laticlavia, and Puntius sp. were restricted to single locations, suggesting specialized microhabitat requirements. IUCN Red List evaluation identified Acantopsis octoactinotos as Vulnerable (VU) and Gastromyzon ctenocephalusas Near Threatened (NT), alongside Data Deficient (DD) and unassessed taxa. This underscores the conservation value of these modified streams. Notably, no exotic or invasive species were detected, indicating reasonable habitat retention despite surrounding agricultural activity. These baseline data provide actionable evidence to guide sustainable land management, riparian corridor retention, and freshwater conservation in Bornean plantation landscapes.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究调查了马来西亚砂拉越加帛Lana油棕园内四条河流的淡水鱼类群落与保护状况，以填补油棕种植区农业溪流鱼类多样性数据的空白。2025年4月采用刺网采样，共记录19种鱼类，以Cyprinidae（55%）和Danionidae（30%）为主，Barbonymus collingwoodii分布最广，而部分物种仅见于单一站点。IUCN评估显示Acantopsis octoactinotos为VU、Gastromyzon ctenocephalus为NT，且未发现外来入侵种，表明该改造溪流仍具一定保护价值。研究为婆罗洲种植园景观的可持续土地管理与淡水保护提供了基线数据。

papers.title: The Impact of Fish Farming on Revenue Generation and Job Creation in Bauchi and Toro Local Government Areas of Bauchi State
papers.authors: Adamu, Yakubu
papers.journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF AGRICULTURE AND EARTH SCIENCE
papers.abstract: This study investigates the impact of fish farming on revenue generation and job creation in Bauchi and Toro Local Government Areas of Bauchi State, Nigeria. The research aims to assess how fish farming contributes to local economic development, focusing on income levels, employment opportunities, and sustainability. A descriptive survey design was employed, and data were collected through structured questionnaires administered to selected fish farmers, government officials, and stakeholders in the fishery sector. The findings reveal that fish farming significantly contributes to household income, enhances food security, and creates both direct and indirect employment opportunities, particularly among youths and women. Additionally, the study highlights the challenges faced by fish farmers, including inadequate access to credit facilities, poor infrastructure, and lack of technical training. The study concludes that with proper support and investment, fish farming holds great potential for enhancing economic growth in the study areas. Recommendations include government intervention in providing subsidies, improved training programs, and better access to markets and finance to boost the sector’s productivity and impact.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过问卷调查评估尼日利亚包奇州Bauchi和Toro地方政府辖区水产养殖对收入创造和就业的影响。结果表明，水产养殖显著提升家庭收入、改善粮食安全，并在青年和女性群体中创造直接与间接就业机会。研究同时指出养殖户面临信贷不足、基础设施薄弱和技术培训缺乏等制约，建议政府通过补贴、培训和市场融资支持促进该产业发展。

papers.title: Identifying Key Factors Associated with the Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Fish Assemblages in Subtropical River-Type Reservoir Ecosystems: Implications for Fishery Management and Conservation
papers.authors: Yin, Chengjie; Zhang, Rongzhen; Feng, Zewen; Shi, Xiaoning; Li, Renhui; Xiang, Miao; Zhang, He; Guo, Longgen
papers.abstract: Characterizing the spatiotemporal patterns of fish communities in subtropical river-type reservoirs provides useful baseline information for fisheries stewardship and aquatic ecosystem monitoring. This work investigated fish assemblages across 18 sampling sites within Shanxi Reservoir, Zhejiang Province, using an integrative approach combining gillnet surveys, hydroacoustic detection, and habitat parameter monitoring. Sampling was conducted during two periods: October 2022 (autumn, post-flood, fattening phase) and April 2023 (spring, normal water level, spawning phase). A total of 22 species were documented in spring and 21 in autumn, with Cyprinidae species predominating. Dominant species shifted seasonally, led by Hypophthalmichthys nobilis, Culter dabryi and Hemiculter leucisculus. Planktivores and carnivores were more abundant in spring, while omnivores increased in autumn. Spatially, fish populations were mainly concentrated in the shallow riverine zone (SRZ), predominantly comprising small- to medium-sized individuals. Mantel tests and Pearson correlation analyses identified associations between fish assemblage structure in the deep lake zone (DLZ) and environmental variables including dissolved oxygen, conductivity, chlorophyll a, and phytoplankton density and biomass. This study provides preliminary baseline data on fish community dynamics in Shanxi Reservoir and offers tentative observations that may help inform future zoned monitoring and ecological restoration planning.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以浙江珊溪水库为对象，结合刺网调查、水声学探测与栖息地参数监测，于2022年秋季和2023年春季在18个采样点调查鱼类群落，旨在揭示亚热带河流型水库鱼类群落的时空动态及其驱动因子。共记录春季22种、秋季21种，以鲤科鱼类为主，优势种随季节更替，春季以浮游食性和肉食性鱼类占优，秋季杂食性鱼类增加；空间上鱼类主要集中于浅水河流区（SRZ），个体以中小型为主。Mantel检验与Pearson相关分析表明，深水湖泊区（DLZ）鱼类群落结构与溶解氧、电导率、叶绿素a及浮游植物密度和生物量等环境因子相关。研究为珊溪水库鱼类群落动态提供了初步基线数据，可为分区监测与生态修复规划提供参考。

papers.title: EHDS-YOLO: a lightweight side-scan sonar object detection model for intelligent underwater inspection in marine ranching
papers.authors: Liu, Zejin; Zhang, Yiming; Yang, Yanqiang; Wen, Bang; Sha, Yida; Lin, Yuanshan
papers.summary_cn: 针对海洋牧场水下智能巡检需求，提出轻量化侧扫声呐目标检测模型EHDS-YOLO，旨在提升侧扫声呐图像中目标检测的精度与效率。

papers.title:
Decoding the Dynamic
Evolution and Metabolic Pathways
of Volatile and Non-Volatile Flavors in Prepared Fish Fillets during
Boiling: An Integrated Approach of HS-SPME-GC-MS, HS-GC-IMS, E-Nose,
and Chemometrics
papers.authors: Liu, Ziying; Ruan, Xuwen; Tu, Zongcai; Li, Jun; Guo, Debin; Zhong, Liping; Wang, Hui
papers.journal:
Journal of Agricultural
and Food Chemistry
papers.abstract: Abstract This study examined how boiling time (0–150 s) affects the flavor of prepared grass carp fillets. Using headspace solid-phase microextraction gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (HS-SPME-GC-MS) and headspace gas chromatography-ion mobility spectrometry (HS-GC-IMS), we identified 146 volatile organic compounds (VOCs), of which 15 were defined as key odorants. Shorter boiling (30–60 s) enhanced the release of volatiles like 1-octen-3-ol and (Z)-4-heptenal, imparting mushroom and fruity notes. The 90 s stage featured nutty and oily aromas from compounds such as 2,5-dimethyl-3-isopropylpyrazine and heptanal. Extended boiling (120–150 s) led to the dominance of sweet and grassy notes from isoeugenol and propionaldehyde. The core free amino acids (FAAs)─aspartic acid (Asp), glutamic acid (Glu), and histidine (His)─shaped the primary taste profile, and VOC formation was closely linked to amino acid and nucleotide metabolism. This work provides a theoretical basis for optimizing the flavor quality of prepared fish products.
papers.summary_cn: 研究采用HS-SPME-GC-MS、HS-GC-IMS、电子鼻及化学计量学方法，考察了0–150 s煮沸时间对预制草鱼鱼片风味的影响。共鉴定出146种挥发性有机化合物（VOCs），其中15种为关键气味物质；短时煮沸（30–60 s）增强1-辛烯-3-醇和(Z)-4-庚烯醛释放，赋予蘑菇和果香，90 s阶段呈现坚果和油脂香，120–150 s则以甜香和青草香为主。核心游离氨基酸（Asp、Glu、His）决定基础滋味轮廓，VOC形成与氨基酸及核苷酸代谢密切相关，为优化预制鱼制品风味品质提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Biological and Genetic Factors Influencing Fish Production in  Nigeria
papers.authors: Okeke, P. A
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF BIOLOGY AND GENETIC RESEARCH
papers.abstract: Aquaculture plays a vital role in food security, employment generation, and economic development in Nigeria. However, the productivity and sustainability of aquaculture systems are strongly influenced by the biological characteristics and genetic composition of cultured fish species. This paper reviews the biological and genetic factors affecting aquaculture production in Nigeria, focusing on major cultured species such as Clarias gariepinus, Oreochromis niloticus, Heterobranchus bidorsalis, and Tilapia guineensis. Biological traits including growth rate, fecundity, environmental tolerance, feeding behaviour, and disease resistance significantly influence aquaculture productivity. Genetic factors such as genetic diversity, selective breeding, hybridization, broodstock management, and molecular genetic technologies also play a critical role in improving fish performance and survival in culture systems. Despite the rapid growth of aquaculture in Nigeria, challenges such as inbreeding depression, poor broodstock management, limited selective breeding programs, and inadequate application of molecular genetic tools continue to hinder productivity. Recent advances in aquaculture genetics, including genomic selection, molecular markers, and biotechnology, offer significant opportunities for improving fish strains and increasing production efficiency. This review highlights the importance of integrating biological knowledge with modern genetic improvement strategies to enhance sustainable aquaculture development in Nigeria.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦尼日利亚水产养殖主要养殖种类（如 *Clarias gariepinus*、*Oreochromis niloticus* 等），系统梳理了影响鱼类产量的生物学因素（生长率、繁殖力、环境耐受性、摄食行为、抗病力）与遗传因素（遗传多样性、选择育种、杂交、亲鱼管理、分子遗传技术）。研究指出，近交衰退、亲鱼管理不善、选择育种项目有限及分子遗传工具应用不足是制约尼日利亚水产养殖生产力的主要瓶颈。综述强调，将生物学知识与基因组选择、分子标记等现代遗传改良策略相结合，对提升养殖效率、实现可持续水产养殖发展具有重要意义。

papers.title:
Receptor-Based Functional Characterization Reveals
Synergistic Umami Enhancement of Anchovy Fish Sauce-Derived Peptides
with Monosodium Glutamate
papers.authors: Wang, Yueyue; Zhang, Huiru; Tian, Yuhan; Xu, Xianbing; Zhang, Ling; Du, Ming; Wu, Rina; Tian, Shiyi; Qin, Yumei; Zhao, Qiyue
papers.journal: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry
papers.abstract: Abstract The mechanistic quantification of umami synergy has long been impeded by conventional sensory evaluation and electronic tongues, which fail to dissect multiligand synergistic effects from receptor recognition and signal transduction perspectives. This study established a multidimensional screening strategy integrating machine learning, molecular docking, and cellular validation, identifying four umami peptides (SDHE, NE, TRE, TMHE) from anchovy fish sauce. Sensory tests showed that these peptides had weak umami intensity alone (score 5–6), but significantly enhanced umami intensity (score 6–8) and prolonged aftertaste (80–110 s) when coadded with MSG. Calcium signaling assays using HEK-293 cells stably expressing human T1R1/T1R3 confirmed these peptides act as positive allosteric modulators, amplifying MSG-triggered signals by 1.07–2.29-fold. Molecular docking revealed that cobinding of these peptides with MSG at the Venus flytrap domain increased the number of noncovalent interactions from 5 to 8–17. This study provides direct receptor-level evidence of umami synergy and lays a foundation for discovering natural synergistic umami enhancers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过整合机器学习、分子对接与细胞验证的多维筛选策略，从鳀鱼鱼露中鉴定出四种鲜味肽（SDHE、NE、TRE、TMHE）。感官实验表明这些肽单独鲜味较弱，但与MSG共添加后显著增强鲜味强度并延长回味。钙信号实验证实其作为正别构调节剂作用于T1R1/T1R3受体，分子对接揭示共结合使非共价相互作用数显著增加，为鲜味协同效应提供了受体层面的直接证据。

papers.title: Relationships Between Oceanic Primary Production, Human Habitation and Variation in the Life‐History Traits of Coral Reef Fishes Across the Northern Line Islands
papers.authors: Zgliczynski, Brian J.; Caldwell, Lindsay T.; Williams, Gareth J.; Hamilton, Scott L.; Wood, Chelsea L.; Friedlander, Alan M.; Akiona, Anela K.; Eynaud, Yoan; DeMartini, Edward E.; Sandin, Stuart A.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Biophysical processes associated with large‐scale nearshore oceanographic upwelling can influence coral reef communities by increasing the delivery of nutrient subsidies and food resources to reefs. However, these processes occur alongside anthropogenic activities that may alter ecological patterns across coral reef ecosystems. We examined relationships among nearshore oceanic primary production, human habitation, and the abundance, biomass, body condition and life‐history traits of eight common coral reef fish species across six islands in the Northern Line Islands, central Pacific Ocean. Variation in oceanic primary production and habitation status was associated with differences in abundance, biomass, body condition and life‐history traits (i.e., growth rates, maximum size and longevity) of key coral reef fishes. These relationships varied among species and islands, with some taxa exhibiting more pronounced relationships with productivity and human habitation than others. Among uninhabited islands, several grazer‐detritivore species exhibited life‐history patterns that were consistent with variation in oceanic primary production, whereas these relationships between productivity and life‐history traits were less apparent among inhabited islands. In contrast, piscivore‐invertivore species generally exhibited stronger differences associated with human habitation status. These findings suggest that local human impacts may influence life‐history traits of reef fishes even when strong gradients in oceanic primary production are present. Although the mechanisms underlying these patterns were not evaluated directly, our results highlight the role of biophysical processes in shaping coral reef fish assemblages and suggest that human activities may alter ecological relationships linking environmental conditions and life‐history traits across tropical reef ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以中太平洋北莱恩群岛六座岛屿为对象，探讨近岸海洋初级生产力与人类居住状况对八种常见珊瑚礁鱼类的丰度、生物量、体况及生活史特征（生长率、最大体型、寿命）的影响。结果显示，初级生产力与居住状况均与鱼类上述特征的变化相关，但关系因物种和岛屿而异：在无人岛上，部分食草-碎屑食性鱼类的 life-history traits 与初级生产力变化一致，而在有人岛上该关系减弱；食鱼-食无脊椎动物鱼类则更多受人类居住状况影响。研究表明，即便存在强烈的海洋初级生产力梯度，局部人类活动仍可能改变珊瑚礁鱼类生活史特征及其与环境条件之间的生态关系。

papers.title: Common census methods can lead to fundamentally different ecological interpretations of coral reef fish communities
papers.authors: Yan, Helen F.; Crisp, Samantha K.; Bellwood, David R.; Siqueira, Alexandre C.; Tebbett, Sterling B.
papers.abstract: Abstract In an era of large-scale stressors, scientists are racing to collate equally large datasets to answer macroecological questions. Coral reefs lie at the forefront of system-wide transformations and are thus the focus of many macroecological studies. A lack of standardised, global data across time, however, has resulted in the coalition of data from disparate sources, often comprising different survey methods. However, can we make the same ecological inferences from data collected using different survey protocols? Here, we employed two of the most common reef fish census techniques—point counts and belt transects—of varying survey effort (time and area) to assess whether we can draw similar ecological conclusions from different methods. We found that point counts produced the most extreme estimates of abundance, biomass, and species richness across all methods, with instant point counts recording the lowest and 10-min point counts recording the highest values; underscoring the potential for total survey time to influence results. Likely owing to the near-maximum diver effect, point counts also consistently missed the largest fishes on the reef and were characterised by common species. Consequently, point counts produced biomass-size distributions that were vastly different from belt transects, which could lead to markedly different interpretations of the energetic profiles of fish communities. Combining reef fish data collected using different survey methods can bias inferences, as survey time can produce abundance-based biases, while survey methods can produce size-based biases. Regardless of survey method, we found that each site would need at least 30 individual transects to precisely quantify community dynamics. Using uniform survey methods with enough replication would ensure biases and errors are more consistent, which can lead to more robust inferences.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了 point counts 与 belt transects 两种珊瑚礁鱼类调查方法在不同调查努力（时间和面积）下能否得出相似的生态学结论。结果显示，point counts 产生的丰度、生物量和物种丰富度估计最为极端，且因接近最大潜水员效应而系统性遗漏大型鱼类、偏向常见种，其生物量-体长分布与 belt transects 差异显著，可能导致对鱼类群落能量结构的截然不同解读。调查时间可引入丰度偏差，调查方法可引入体长偏差，混合不同方法的数据会偏倚推断；无论采用何种方法，每个站点至少需30条样带才能精确量化群落动态。

papers.title: Amphipoda (Crustacea, Peracarida) associated with the octocoral <i>Carijoa riisei</i> (Cnidaria, Anthozoa) in estuarine and reef environments of northeastern Brazil<b></b>
papers.authors: De Pádua, Stella M. F.; Nascimento, Liliana do Carmo; Souza-Filho, Jesser F.; Botter- Carvalho, Mônica L.; Gomes, Paula Braga; Pérez, Carlos D.
papers.abstract: Carijoa riisei is a branching colonial octocoral widely distributed in reef and estuarine environments along the coast of Pernambuco, northeastern Brazil. Owing to the structural complexity of its colonies, it provides both habitat and substrate for a diverse assemblage of associated organisms. This study investigated the structure of the amphipod community associated with C. riisei in two contrasting environments on the southern coast of Pernambuco: Porto de Galinhas Beach and the Rio Formoso Estuary. Four sampling campaigns were carried out, two at each site, encompassing both the dry and rainy seasons. During each campaign, 12 octocoral colonies were collected, resulting in a total of 48 samples. A total of 26,683 amphipods representing 21 species were recorded. The most abundant species were Ericthonius brasiliensis (57.28%), Laticorophium baconi (10.93%), Podocerus brasiliensis (7.65%), Monocorophium acherusicum (7.54%), and Dulichiella ankeri (5.89%), which together accounted for 89.22% of all individuals collected. Amphipod abundance in the Rio Formoso Estuary was approximately six times greater than that recorded at Porto de Galinhas. Moreover, L. baconi and M. acherusicum were exclusively found in the estuarine environment. Comparisons of ecological descriptors revealed significant differences between the two sites, with the estuary exhibiting higher amphipod abundance and diversity. These findings suggest that estuarine conditions, including greater nutrient availability, higher sediment input, and the influence of water flow and reduced light penetration, promote the establishment of more diverse amphipod assemblages associated with C. riisei.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了巴西东北部两种对比环境（Porto de Galinhas 海滩与 Rio Formoso 河口）中与八放珊瑚 *Carijoa riisei* 共栖的端足类群落结构，于干湿两季各采集两次，共获得48个珊瑚群体样本。共记录端足类26,683个体、21种，优势种为 *Ericthonius brasiliensis*（57.28%）等5种，合计占89.22%。河口区端足类丰度约为礁区的6倍，且 *Laticorophium baconi* 和 *Monocorophium acherusicum* 仅见于河口，表明河口条件（较高营养盐、沉积物输入及水流与光照条件）促进了更多样的端足类群落形成。

papers.title: Tuning into Tuna: Investigating Spatial Complexity Tradeoffs in Stock Assessment Models Based on a High-Resolution Simulation Experiment of Yellowfin Tuna in the Indian Ocean
papers.authors: Izquierdo, Francisco; Cousido-Rocha, Marta; Correa, Giancarlo M.; Cerviño, Santiago; Berger, Aaron M; Goethel, Daniel R.; Hoyle, Simon D.; Lynch, Patrick D; Pennino, Maria Grazia
papers.abstract: Understanding spatial heterogeneity is critical for improving fish stock assessments and sustainable management strategies, especially for highly migratory species such as yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares). This study investigates trade-offs associated with incorporating spatial complexity into stock assessment models, using a high-resolution blinded simulation experiment based on yellowfin tuna in the Indian Ocean. We developed a suite of spatially structured assessment models within the Stock Synthesis 3 framework, incorporating recruitment apportionment, movement dynamics, tagging data, and standardized catch-per-unit-effort (CPUE) indices via Bayesian spatiotemporal models. Under the blinded design, a stepwise modeling process was first applied to a reference dataset to identify the preferred spatial configuration. Selected model steps were then evaluated across 100 stochastic replicates to assess their ability to reproduce the true operating model dynamics. Results highlight that simpler models captured population depletion trends better but substantially underestimated absolute stock size (SSB), whereas increasing spatial complexity greatly reduced SSB bias. Our findings emphasize the importance of balancing model complexity, realism, and management needs when developing stock assessments and offer recommendations for incorporating spatial processes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于印度洋黄鳍金枪鱼的高分辨率盲法模拟实验，在Stock Synthesis 3框架下构建了一系列空间结构化评估模型，纳入补充量分配、移动动态、标记数据和标准化CPUE指数，以探讨stock assessment中空间复杂性的权衡。通过100次随机重复评估不同模型配置对真实操作模型动态的再现能力，发现简单模型能较好捕捉种群衰退趋势但显著低估绝对SSB，而增加空间复杂性可大幅降低SSB偏差。研究强调在stock assessment中需平衡模型复杂性、真实性与管理需求，并为整合空间过程提供了建议。

papers.title: Mitigating the impacts of oligotrophication and thermal stress on Pacific oyster Magallana gigas aquaculture through solar-powered artificial upwelling
papers.authors: Mino, Moriya; Nagata, Yudai; Mino, Fumihiro; Furukawa, Toshiya; Ohara, Shizuka; Koike, Kazuhiko
papers.abstract: Abstract Recent oligotrophication and rising water temperatures in the Seto Inland Sea of Japan have led to a decline in oyster production in Hiroshima Prefecture. This study developed and evaluated the “Seawater Pump-up Apparatus for Localized Oceanic Warming-mitigation” (SPALOW), a device designed to supply cool and nutrient-rich bottom water and diatom resting cells from the sediment to the surface layer. Field trials conducted in Mitsu Bay, Hiroshima in 2023 revealed that the experimental raft equipped with SPALOW exhibited lower surface water temperatures during summer and increased dissolved inorganic nitrogen (DIN) concentrations. Chlorophyll- a concentrations were consistently higher throughout the year, resulting in a 32.7–75.6% increase in the wet weight of oyster soft body compared with the control raft. By simultaneously enhancing phytoplankton availability and mitigating thermal stress, SPALOW represents a promising tool for establishing sustainable and efficient oyster aquaculture systems in the future.
papers.summary_cn: 针对日本濑户内海贫营养化与水温升高导致广岛牡蛎减产的问题，本研究开发并评估了太阳能驱动的人工上升流装置SPALOW，可将底层低温、富营养水及沉积物中硅藻休眠细胞输送至表层。2023年在广岛三津湾的现场试验表明，装备SPALOW的实验筏夏季表层水温降低、DIN浓度升高，叶绿素a全年维持较高水平，牡蛎软体部湿重较对照增加32.7–75.6%。该装置通过同步提升浮游植物供给与缓解热胁迫，为可持续高效牡蛎养殖提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Stable Isotope Analyses of Yellowfin and Blackfin Tuna Eye Lenses Reveal Life History Patterns
papers.authors: Rullo, Kylee M.; Peebles, Ernst B.; Vecchio, Julie L.; Murawski, Steven A.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Spatial geography, ontogenetic movement, and trophic patterns of mobile species are key elements of species life history, and knowledge of them is critical for effective marine resource management. For yellowfin tuna ( Thunnus albacares ; YFT) and blackfin tuna ( Thunnus atlanticus ; BLFT), residency durations and ontogenetic movements in the Gulf of Mexico (Gulf) are uncertain. To evaluate changes in trophic position and movement of YFT ( n = 46) and BLFT ( n = 31) caught in the northern Gulf, we used nitrogen (δ 15 N) and carbon (δ 13 C) stable isotope analysis across eye lenses. Lifetime increases in isotopic values, significant correlations between each isotopic value and laminar midpoint (proxy for length; LM), and a significant correlation between δ 15 N and δ 13 C values would indicate fewer movements across isotopic gradients and the potential for long‐term residency. In this study, all individuals increased in δ 15 N from core to outermost lamina (YFT mean = 4.47‰, BLFT mean = 5.06‰), and 95% of individuals had significant, positive correlations between δ 15 N and LM, consistent with increasing trophic position and/or migration from lower δ 15 N areas to the northern Gulf. Intraspecific smoothed curves of δ 13 C by size exhibited early dips in δ 13 C values and subsequent increases around estimated age 1, revealing possible ontogenetic or seasonal movement by both species. This study was limited in giving a definitive interpretation of movement, but some individual profiles (YFT n = 15, BLFT n = 2) displayed significant, positive correlations between δ 13 C and δ 15 N, signaling a trophic position increase with potential long‐term residencies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用眼晶状体氮（δ15N）和碳（δ13C）稳定同位素分析，评估墨西哥湾北部黄鳍金枪鱼（YFT，n=46）和黑鳍金枪鱼（BLFT，n=31）的营养级变化与个体移动模式。结果显示，所有个体从晶状体核心至外层的δ15N均升高（YFT均值4.47‰，BLFT均值5.06‰），95%个体δ15N与层中点（LM）呈显著正相关，表明营养级升高或由低δ15N区域向墨西哥湾北部迁移。δ13C随体长的平滑曲线在约1龄前后出现先降后升的趋势，提示两种金枪鱼可能存在个体发育或季节性移动；部分个体（YFT n=15，BLFT n=2）δ13C与δ15N显著正相关，暗示营养级升高伴随潜在的长期栖息。

papers.title: A Study on Monoculture of Indigenous Fresh Water Fish Channa striatus in a  Fresh Water Pond in Tamil Nadu, India
papers.authors: Sivakami, R.; Nazar, A. R.; Babu, V.; Rajendiran, A.
papers.abstract: Striped murrel (Channa striatus) is an indigenous freshwater fish of economic and nutritional importance in Tamil Nadu, India. The present study evaluated its monoculture in a perennial freshwater pond at Swamimalai, Kumbakonam Taluk, Tanjore District, over a five-month period from February to July 2026. A total of 1,200 fingerlings with an initial total weight of 7.8 kg were stocked. Natural feed comprising chicken waste, fish waste, and live Gambusia fish was provided together with artificial floating and immersed feeds. Feeding was maintained at 2% of total body weight, and fish growth was assessed at 15-day intervals. At harvest, 986 fish were recovered, corresponding to a survival rate of 82.16%. The harvested fish had a total weight of 436.255 kg, with individual weights ranging from 368.4 to 516.5 g and an average weight of 442.45 g. Fish were marketed according to size at rates ranging from Rs. 320 to Rs. 450 per kg. The total income from the culture operation was Rs. 1,79,063.20, while total expenditure was Rs. 73,650.00, resulting in a net profit of Rs. 1,05,413.20 over five months. The findings indicate that pond-based monoculture of Channa striatus, when supported by appropriate stocking, feeding, and culture management, can provide a productive and economically favourable freshwater aquaculture option under the conditions examined in Tamil Nadu.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在印度泰米尔纳德邦一淡水池塘开展本地种线鳢（Channa striatus）单养试验，放养1200尾鱼种，投喂鸡废料、鱼废料及活体食蚊鱼并辅以人工饲料，养殖5个月。收获986尾，成活率82.16%，总产量436.255 kg，平均体重442.45 g。5个月净利润达105413.20卢比，表明在适当放养与饲养管理下线鳢池塘单养具有较好的生产性能和经济效益。

papers.title: Geometric morphometric analyses of intragenus (Campylomormyrus) and intergenus hybrids in mormyrid fish
papers.authors: Amen, Rahma; Berghäuser, Timo; Kirschbaum, Frank; Tiedemann, Ralph
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Abstract Natural hybrids within the weakly electric mormyrid fish genus Campylomormyrus have not been documented in the wild. However, recent advances have enabled the artificial production of both intragenus ( Campylomormyrus ) and intergenus ( Campylomormyrus and Gnathonemus ) hybrids. While previous studies have focused mainly on phenotypic divergence in body shape, especially electric organ discharges, ecophenotypical divergence in these hybrids remains less explored. To address this gap, we used geometric morphometrics to analyze body shape variation in intragenus and intergenus hybrids relative to their parental species. Using standardized digital photographs, we examined hybrids derived from parental species with varying genetic and phenotypic distances, including distinct snout morphologies. Our results show that hybrids are morphologically distinguishable but generally remain within the phenotypic range of their parental species. In most crosses, hybrids exhibited intermediate morphology or stronger similarity to one parent, whereas transgressive shape segregation was observed only in one cross and did not involve snout length. Snout thickness and body curvature showed more variable patterns among crosses than snout length. These findings suggest that F1 hybrid morphology is shaped mainly by intermediate expression with cross-specific parental affinity, while strongly novel morphologies appear to be rare. This study improves our understanding of hybridization in Mormyridae, its potential relevance for phenotypic diversification, and provides a basis for future work on later hybrid generations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用几何形态计量学（geometric morphometrics）分析了弱电鱼科（Mormyridae）长吻鱼属（Campylomormyrus）属内杂交及长吻鱼属与Gnathonemus属间杂交后代相对于亲本的体型形态变异。结果显示，杂交个体虽可形态区分，但总体仍处于亲本表型范围内，多数杂交组合表现为中间形态或偏向某一亲本，仅一个组合出现超亲形态分离且不涉及吻长。吻厚和体弯曲在组合间变异大于吻长，表明F1杂交形态主要由中间表达和组合特异性亲本亲和力决定，显著新颖形态较为罕见。

papers.title: Community Empowerment in the Aquaculture of Tilapia and Milkfish in Tanjung Rejo Village
papers.authors: Nursa'adah; W, Harya Bimasuci; Siregar, Luthfi A M; Harahap, Edy Syah Putra
papers.abstract: The fisheries sector plays a crucial role in rural development, particularly through the expansion of tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) and milkfish (Chanos chanos) aquaculture, which contributes to community welfare and regional food security. Deli Serdang Regency, North Sumatra, has substantial aquaculture potential, with tilapia production reaching 16,257 tons in 2023. However, small-scale aquaculture in rural areas is still constrained by inadequate production management and post-harvest handling, resulting in limited economic optimization and market development. This study presents a community empowerment program implemented in Tanjung Rejo Village, Percut Sei Tuan District. The program involved structured training, technical mentoring, field-based practices, and the introduction of improved aquaculture technologies. Survey results indicated a significant improvement in community knowledge and skills, with 22% of respondents strongly agreeing and 78% agreeing that the polyculture pond training was beneficial. Furthermore, 75% of respondents strongly agreed and 25% agreed on the need for continued technical assistance in tilapia and milkfish aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对北苏门答腊Tanjung Rejo村罗非鱼（Oreochromis niloticus）和虱目鱼（Chanos chanos）小规模养殖中生产管理与采后处理不足的问题，实施了包含结构化培训、技术指导、田间实践和改良养殖技术引入的社区赋能项目。调查结果显示，22%的受访者非常认同、78%认同混养池塘培训有益，75%非常认同、25%认同需要持续的技术支持。研究表明社区赋能干预可有效提升养殖户的知识与技能水平。

papers.title: Fish Diversity and Its Relation to Water Quality Parameters of Markonahalli Reservoir, Tumkur District, Karnataka, India
papers.authors: S. R., Chalapathi; H. M., Lalitha
papers.abstract: Markonahalli Reservoir in Tumkur District, Karnataka, is used mainly for irrigation and fishing. This study assessed fish diversity and selected physicochemical water-quality parameters from February 2024 to January 2025 to examine reservoir conditions in relation to the recorded fish community. Fish were collected with the assistance of local fishermen using nets of different sizes and types, while water samples were collected monthly from four sampling sites. Water temperature, pH, turbidity, electrical conductivity, nitrate, sulphate, dissolved oxygen, and biological oxygen demand were analysed using standard methods. A total of 16 fish species representing 14 genera, seven families, and five orders were recorded, with Cypriniformes forming the dominant taxonomic group. The measured parameters showed spatial and seasonal variation across the sampling sites. Turbidity ranged from 2.75±0.418 to 6.25±0.7275 NTU, while electrical conductivity ranged from 403±11.358 to 856.33±14.263 µS/cm. Nitrate concentrations ranged from 2.425±0.025 to 4.825±0.307 mg/L, and sulphate ranged from 5±2.00 to 34±2.122 mg/L. Dissolved oxygen varied from 4.85±0.593 to 6.5333±0.177 mg/L, whereas biological oxygen demand ranged from 2.4667±0.134 to 4.4±0.548 mg/L. The findings provide baseline information on fish diversity and seasonal water-quality conditions in Markonahalli Reservoir and support continued monitoring for the sustainable management of its fishery and aquatic resources over time.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究于2024年2月至2025年1月对印度Karnataka州Markonahalli水库的鱼类多样性与水质参数进行了调查，通过不同网具采集鱼类并每月在四个站点测定理化指标。共记录16种鱼类，隶属14属7科5目，以Cypriniformes为优势类群；水质参数（浊度、电导率、硝酸盐、硫酸盐、溶解氧、BOD等）呈现明显的空间和季节变化。研究为该水库鱼类资源与水质的可持续管理提供了基线数据。

papers.title: Projecting climate-driven biogeographic shifts and niche divergence of three endangered marine fishes in the Indo-West Pacific: implications for regional conservation priorities and transboundary management
papers.authors: Huang, Yixuan; Xu, Shihong; Zhou, Tao; Wu, Peng; Zhang, Zhi; Du, Feiyan; Xiao, Zhizhong; Li, Jun; Xiao, Yongshuang
papers.summary_cn: 基于生态位模型预测印度-西太平洋三种濒危海鱼在气候变化情景下的生物地理迁移与生态位分化，旨在为区域保护优先区和跨境管理提供依据。

papers.title: Developing Guidance for Supporting the Implementation of an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management by Deep-sea RFMOs
papers.authors: Thompson, Anthony; Hidas, Eszter; Vasconcellos, Marcelo
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: The Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries (EAF) was adopted by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) as a practical framework for fisheries management according to the Code of Conduct for Responsible Fisheries. An EAF recognises that fish and fisheries are part of and dependent upon the entire marine ecosystem and that fisheries management must balance human and ecological considerations in a comprehensive way to achieve sustainable outcomes. This paper elaborates on the inclusion of EAF in international law, the existing guidance to support EAF implementation, and the achievements and challenges remaining for the implementation of the approach by Regional Fisheries Management Organizations (RFMOs) dealing with deep sea fisheries. The implementation of EAF by the RFMOs responsible for demersal and small pelagic species is reviewed and discussed. The authors suggest that future steps should include developing and adopting specific multiannual EAF management and action plans to assist RFMOs in implementing EAF. This should include setting long-term objectives and targets. The process of developing these plans would be enhanced through discussions within joint science-management meetings and workshops within RFMOs.
papers.summary_cn: 本文探讨了深海区域渔业管理组织（RFMOs）实施生态系统方法（EAF）的现状与挑战，梳理了EAF在国际法中的纳入情况及现有指导框架，并回顾了负责底层鱼类和小型中上层鱼类的RFMOs的EAF实施进展。作者建议未来应制定并通过具体的多年期EAF管理计划与行动计划，设定长期目标与指标，并通过RFMOs内部科学-管理联合会议与研讨会推动相关进程。

papers.title: Advancing an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management in the Northeast Atlantic: ICES’s Scientific Framework, Advice Products, and Implementation Pathways
papers.authors: Salvany, Lara; Campbell, Neil; Martinez, Inigo; Cooper, Anne; Lordan, Colm
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: Achieving marine management objectives and long-term sustainability requires moving beyond conventional, single-species management, towards an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management (EAFM), that accounts for complex ecological interactions, cumulative human pressures, and environmental variability. The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) advances EAFM in the Northeast Atlantic by providing scientific frameworks and advice products that address fundamental aspects of EAFM: understanding the ecosystem’s influence on fisheries, quantifying fisheries’ impact on the wider ecosystem, contextualizing fisheries among other pressures, and analyzing trade-offs between competing management objectives. Examples are provided for ICES integration of ecosystem information into advice, including the ecosystem-based fishing mortality reference point (FECO), the regional benthic impact assessments and trade-off analysis and the ICES Framework for Ecosystem-Informed Science and Advice (FEISA). These examples illustrate how ICES is moving from the single species model and contextual ecosystem assessment towards more operational ecosystem-informed advice. Despite progress, key challenges remain, including a fragmented governance structure and a lack of clear, formalized process translating ecosystem advice into management actions. Furthermore, there are significant data gaps concerning social and economic dimensions that need to be addressed to truly achieve a comprehensive EAFM.
papers.summary_cn: 本文旨在阐述ICES在东北大西洋推进Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management (EAFM)的科学框架、建议产品及实施路径。ICES通过整合生态系统信息，开发了ecosystem-based fishing mortality reference point (FECO)、区域性底栖影响评估与权衡分析以及FEISA框架等工具，推动从单鱼种评估向可操作的生态系统知情建议转变。然而，治理结构碎片化、生态系统建议向管理行动转化的正式机制缺失以及社会经济维度数据不足，仍是全面实现EAFM的主要挑战。

papers.title: Diets of Macrobrachium species in Lower Orashi River, Niger Delta, Nigeria: Implication for Ecosystem Conservation and Sustainable Shrimp Fisheries
papers.authors: Amachree, D
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF BIOLOGY AND GENETIC RESEARCH
papers.abstract: Food and feeding habits are crucial tools for stock management and play a significant role in investigating trophic relationships within aquatic communities. The diets of three Macrobrachium species: Macrobrachium felicinum, Macrobrachium macrobrachion, and Macrobrachium vollenhovenii in the Lower Orashi River were studied over 12 months (December 2019–November 2020) using the frequency of occurrence and numerical methods. The results indicated that a total of 880 food items were observed in the guts of M. vollenhovenii. Out of which, Chlorophyta (n=339; 38.53%) was the highest and the least was Chrysophyta (n=3; 0.34%) In the Chlorophyta category, Chlorella vulgaris (n=135; 15.34%) contributed the highest. The frequency of occurrence method indicated Cyanophyta (n=31; 31.31%) as the most frequently occurred category of food item. Six hundred and ninety-seven (697) food items were found in the guts of M. felicinum with Bacillariophyta (n=400; 57.38%) recorded as the highest number of food items and the least was Crustaceans (n=6; 0.86%) Dinophyta, Charophyta and Rhodophyta were absent in the gut content. In Bacillariophyta category, Melosira varians contributed highest (n=240; 34.43%). Likewise, the frequency of occurrence method indicated Bacillariophyta (n=38; 38.77%) as the most frequently occurring food for M. felicinum. A total of 1006 food items was found in the guts of M. macrobrachion, with the highest number of food item recorded as Bacillariophyta (n=366; 36.40%) and least was Crustaceans (n=3; 0.30%). Chrysophyta, Insects, Charophyta, and Rhodophyta were absent in the gut. In Bacillariophyta category, Melosira varians contributed highest (n=223; 22.17%). For the frequency of occurrence, Chlorophyta (n=33; 33.66%) recorded the highest frequency of occurrence and least was Crustaceans (n=1; 1.02%). In conclusion, all three species of Macrobrachium from the Lower Orashi River are opportunistic omnivore feeder predominantly with preference for phytoplankton however, variations in their primary food items reflect differences in habitat preferences and ecological roles. These findings underscore the importance of phytoplankton as a foundational resource in freshwater ecosystems and the adaptability of Macrobrachium species to exploit available resources
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过12个月（2019年12月–2020年11月）的胃含物分析，采用出现频率法和数量法，调查了尼日尔三角洲Lower Orashi River中三种Macrobrachium（M. felicinum、M. macrobrachion、M. vollenhovenii）的食性。结果表明三种虾均为机会性杂食者，以phytoplankton为主，但主要饵料组成存在种间差异：M. vollenhovenii以Chlorophyta为主，M. felicinum和M. macrobrachion均以Bacillariophyta为主。研究揭示了phytoplankton作为淡水生态系统基础资源的重要性及Macrobrachium属对可用资源的适应性，为stock management和可持续shrimp fisheries提供依据。

papers.title: From Principle to Practice: A Pragmatic Pathway for Ecosystem-Based Fisheries Management in a Data-limited RFMO
papers.authors: Milardi, Marco
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: The Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA) is legally mandated through its founding agreement to implement an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management (EAFM). However, like many Regional Fisheries Management Organizations (RFMOs), translating this principle into effective practice poses significant challenges, particularly in data-limited environments. This viewpoint paper traces SIOFA’s pragmatic journey in operationalizing EAFM. We detail the organization’s early adaptive strategies, which included precautionary alignment with other RFMOs for managing seabirds and Vulnerable Marine Ecosystems (VMEs), and evidence-based conservation measures for deepwater sharks driven by targeted ecological risk assessments. While effective, these approaches highlighted a fundamental barrier: the Scientific Committee’s limited access to integrated fisheries data. In response, SIOFA developed an internal synthesis tool—the SIOFA Ecosystem Summary, to synthesize and streamline data access, thereby directly supporting science-based advice. This perspective paper argues that SIOFA’s experience demonstrates a pragmatic, phased pathway for EAFM implementation that reflects broader trends among RFMOs. While similar ecosystem synthesis tools exist in other bodies (e.g., NAFO, ICES, IOTC), SIOFA’s process is distinctive in its iterative co-development between the Secretariat and Scientific Committee within a resource-constrained setting. This paper contends that such adaptive, context-sensitive approaches offer practical insights for data-limited RFMOs seeking to operationalize EAFM.
papers.summary_cn: 本文以南方印度洋渔业协定（SIOFA）为例，探讨数据有限型RFMO如何将EAFM原则转化为实践。SIOFA早期通过与其它RFMO协同采取预防性措施管理海鸟和VMEs，并基于生态风险评估对深海鲨鱼实施养护措施，但科学委员会获取综合渔业数据的受限成为核心障碍。为此SIOFA开发了内部数据整合工具“SIOFA Ecosystem Summary”，以支持科学建议的制定。文章认为，这种在资源受限条件下由秘书处与科学委员会迭代共同开发的自适应、情境敏感路径，为数据有限型RFMO实施EAFM提供了务实的分阶段参考。

papers.title: Weak governance, cumulative impacts, and socioeconomic factors driving vulnerability in coastal small-scale fisheries
papers.authors: Jankowsky, Mayra; Machado, Ingrid Cabral; de Oliveira, Jacqueline Barbosa Mendonça; Sisdeli, Marcos; Passarelli, Isis Preti; Cardoso, Rodrigo Santana
papers.abstract: Abstract This study analyzes the dynamics of vulnerability in coastal small-scale fisheries under high level of pressure from port-industrial complex in Baixada Santista, Brazil. We employed a socioeconomic survey ( n = 401), transdisciplinary focus-group workshops ( n = 6) with fishers ( n = 40), and stakeholder semi-structured interviews ( n = 5). Our results reveal that vulnerability is multifaceted and shaped by: (i) increased exposure and sensitivity driven by cumulative environmental impacts, particularly those associated with port activities; (ii) underlying socioeconomic conditions, including gender inequality, lack of professional documentation, and irregular housing; (iii) weak governance, characterized by the absence of a formal arenas for conflict resolution and fragmented environmental licensing processes with limited participation; and (iv) adaptive capacity, present in all communities but insufficient to transform the prevailing vulnerability scenario. In addition, local environmental knowledge reveals that socioenvironmental impacts accumulated over time have intensified vulnerability by eroding the foundations of fishing livelihoods through the loss of fishing grounds and the decline of fishery resources, thereby undermining fishing territories. We conclude that transforming vulnerability in coastal small-scale fisheries requires inclusive and multi-scalar maritime governance, strengthened environmental licensing practices, and the meaningful incorporation of local ecological knowledge into decision-making processes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以巴西Baixada Santista地区为案例，综合社会经济调查（n=401）、跨学科焦点小组（n=6）及利益相关者访谈，分析了港口工业综合体高压下沿海小规模渔业的脆弱性动态。结果表明，脆弱性由累积环境影响的暴露与敏感性、性别不平等与缺乏职业登记等社会经济条件、缺乏正式冲突解决平台与碎片化环境许可程序所体现的弱治理，以及不足以扭转脆弱性局面的适应能力共同塑造；地方生态知识进一步揭示，渔场丧失与渔业资源衰退持续侵蚀捕捞生计基础。研究提出需通过包容性多尺度海洋治理、强化环境许可实践及将地方生态知识纳入决策来转变脆弱性。

papers.title: Unseen but Connected: Exploring How Connectivity Informs the Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management in the Northwest Atlantic Fisheries Organization
papers.authors: Kenchington, Ellen
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: Connectivity, a key property of marine ecosystems operating over various spatial scales, relies on movements of organisms, nutrients and energy. Those can be active, involving directed migration, or passive, the latter relying on transport by physical mechanisms that transport organisms, including gametes and larvae. Dispersal drives population dynamics and community structure, hence is an essential component to consider in an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management (EAFM). In the Northwest Atlantic Fisheries Organization (NAFO), connectivity has been considered in a number of different contexts and applications. The distribution ranges of major marine fish species, a product of their dispersal, amongst other aspects, helped to inform the establishment of Bioregions, Ecosystem Production Units, and Ecoregions – nested spatial scales identified as relevant to the development of ecosystem summaries and management plans. For sessile and sedentary benthic species, such as the corals and sponges identified as Vulnerable Marine Ecosystem (VME) indicators, connectivity within and among high-density habitats is key to habitat formation and continuation. In such species, connectivity is governed by larval transport, predominantly by bottom currents. Recently, NAFO has used 3-D Lagrangian particle tracking models to identify connectivity networks of both the closed areas and identified VME habitats, in support of an EAFM. Here, an overview of how NAFO has incorporated information on connectivity into its decision-making processes is provided.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在探讨connectivity（连通性）如何为西北大西洋渔业组织（NAFO）的Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management（EAFM）提供科学支撑。NAFO已将连通性信息应用于多个管理场景，包括基于主要鱼类分布范围划定Bioregions、Ecosystem Production Units和Ecoregions等嵌套空间尺度，以及利用3-D Lagrangian粒子追踪模型识别封闭区域和VME栖息地的连通性网络。对于珊瑚和海绵等VME指示种的底栖固着生物，幼虫随底层洋流的输运决定了栖息地的形成与维持。该综述系统梳理了NAFO将连通性纳入决策过程的实践路径。

papers.title: Standards to Inform an Ecosystem Approach to Deep-sea Bottom Fisheries Management in the High Seas: Examples from the South Pacific Ocean
papers.authors: Tablada, Jordi; Geange, Shane; Arkhipkin, Alexander; Biggerstaff, Andrew; Tunley, Karen; Cryer, Martin; Timmiss, Trent; Hiddink, Jan; Georgeson, Lee; Rowden, Ashley
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: The South Pacific Regional Fisheries Management Organisation (SPRFMO) Convention requires consideration of risks and impacts as part of an ecosystem approach to fisheries management. In SPRFMO, assessments of the impact of demersal fisheries are guided by the Bottom Fishery Impact Assessment Standard and the Encounter Review Standard. The Bottom Fishery Impact Assessment Standard describes a standardised approach for assessing cumulative impacts of bottom fishing, including for new and exploratory fisheries, on Vulnerable Marine Ecosystems (VMEs), deep-sea fish stocks and marine mammals, reptiles, seabirds and other species of concern. The Encounter Review Standard describes responsibilities when reviewing potential encounters with VMEs, which occur when bycatch of VME indicator taxa (e.g., stony corals) in any trawl tow reach or exceed predefined encounter thresholds, resulting in temporary suspension of fishing in the encounter area. Both the Bottom Fishery Impact Assessment Standard and the Encounter Review Standard are periodically updated to reflect best practice, alignment with the FAO International Guidelines for the Management of Deep-sea Fisheries in the High Seas, and account for the best available scientific information required to protect VMEs from significant adverse impacts while ensuring sustainable management of bottom fisheries. Here, we detail the structure and function of these two standards, their periodic updates to reflect best practice and scientific knowledge, and their role in operationalising an ecosystem approach. We also discuss gaps, uncertainties, and potential future improvements for these standards, including the need for better integration of cumulative impacts (such as climate change and cross-sectoral pressures) into the standards, and the usefulness of having universal assessment standards for RFMOs. Through the examples from SPRFMO, we illustrate the importance and role standards can play in achieving sustainable, science-based management of deep-sea fisheries in areas beyond national jurisdiction.
papers.summary_cn: 南太平洋区域渔业管理组织（SPRFMO）依据其《底层渔业影响评估标准》和《遭遇审查标准》，对底层渔业累积影响及VME遭遇事件实施规范化管理，以落实生态系统方法。前者用于评估底层捕捞对新开发渔业及VMEs、深海鱼类种群和受关注物种的累积影响，后者规定当VME指示类群（如石珊瑚）兼捕量达到或超过预设阈值时，须暂停该区域捕捞。两套标准定期更新以反映最佳实践并与FAO《公海深海渔业管理国际准则》保持一致，但目前在累积影响（如气候变化和跨部门压力）整合及RFMO通用评估标准方面仍存在不足。
